# Alan servislerinin davranış referansı

04 belgesi dış sözleşmeyi verir. Bu ekte ilgili router adını arayarak izin denetimini, çağırdığı alan servisini, hata yanıtlarını ve veri değişikliklerini izleyin. Supervisor ve FQICI için ayrıca 02 belgesindeki akışları kullanın. Buradaki kod eski sürümün davranış referansıdır.

````python
def seed_default_experiment(db) -> ABExperiment:
    """Varsayılan A/B test deneyini veritabanına ekler (yoksa)."""
    existing = db.scalars(select(ABExperiment)).first()
    if existing:
        return existing

    variants = [
        {
            "id": "control",
            "name": "Kontrol — Standart Akış",
            "weight": 50,
            "prompt_template": "standard",
            "tts_seed": 9,
            "greeting_template": "standard",
            "description": "Standart prompt + Standart karşılama + Leyla Seed 9",
        },
        {
            "id": "variant_b",
            "name": "Varyant B — Samimi & Hızlı",
            "weight": 50,
            "prompt_template": "friendly",
            "tts_seed": 9,
            "greeting_template": "friendly",
            "description": "Samimi prompt + Sıcak karşılama + Leyla Seed 9",
        },
    ]

    exp = ABExperiment(
        name="Karşılama & Prompt Optimizasyonu (A/B Test)",
        description="Farklı diyalog karşılama tonları (Standart vs Samimi) ve TTS ses tohumlarının randevu dönüşüm oranına etkisini ölçer.",
        experiment_type="composite",
        status="active",
        variants_json=json.dumps(variants, ensure_ascii=False),
        target_metric="conversion_rate",
    )
    db.add(exp)
    db.commit()
    return exp


def get_all_experiments(db) -> list[dict]:
    experiments = db.scalars(
        select(ABExperiment).order_by(ABExperiment.created_at.desc())
    ).all()
    results = []
    for exp in experiments:
        try:
            vars_list = json.loads(exp.variants_json)
        except Exception:
            vars_list = []

        # Count total assignments
        total_assignments = db.scalar(
            select(func.count(ABAssignment.id)).where(
                ABAssignment.experiment_id == exp.id
            )
        ) or 0

        # Converted count
        converted_count = db.scalar(
            select(func.count(ABAssignment.id)).where(
                and_(
                    ABAssignment.experiment_id == exp.id,
                    ABAssignment.outcome == "converted",
                )
            )
        ) or 0

        c_rate = round((converted_count / total_assignments * 100), 1) if total_assignments > 0 else 0.0

        results.append({
            "id": exp.id,
            "name": exp.name,
            "description": exp.description,
            "experiment_type": exp.experiment_type,
            "status": exp.status,
            "target_metric": exp.target_metric,
            "variants": vars_list,
            "variants_count": len(vars_list),
            "total_sessions": total_assignments,
            "converted_sessions": converted_count,
            "conversion_rate": c_rate,
            "created_at": exp.created_at,
            "updated_at": exp.updated_at,
        })
    return results


def get_experiment_by_id(db, experiment_id: str) -> dict | None:
    exp = db.get(ABExperiment, experiment_id)
    if not exp:
        return None
    try:
        vars_list = json.loads(exp.variants_json)
    except Exception:
        vars_list = []
    return {
        "id": exp.id,
        "name": exp.name,
        "description": exp.description,
        "experiment_type": exp.experiment_type,
        "status": exp.status,
        "target_metric": exp.target_metric,
        "variants": vars_list,
        "variants_count": len(vars_list),
        "created_at": exp.created_at,
        "updated_at": exp.updated_at,
    }


def create_experiment(
    db,
    *,
    name: str,
    description: str = "",
    experiment_type: str = "composite",
    variants: list[dict],
    target_metric: str = "conversion_rate",
) -> dict:
    if not name or not name.strip():
        raise ValueError("Deney adı boş olamaz")
    if not variants or len(variants) < 2:
        raise ValueError("A/B testi için en az 2 varyant (Kontrol ve Varyant B) gereklidir")

    cleaned_variants = []
    total_weight = 0
    for idx, v in enumerate(variants):
        vid = v.get("id") or f"variant_{idx + 1}"
        vname = v.get("name") or f"Varyant {idx + 1}"
        weight = int(v.get("weight", 50))
        total_weight += weight
        cleaned_variants.append({
            "id": vid,
            "name": vname,
            "weight": weight,
            "prompt_template": v.get("prompt_template", "standard"),
            "tts_seed": int(v.get("tts_seed", 9)),
            "greeting_template": v.get("greeting_template", "standard"),
            "description": v.get("description", ""),
        })

    if total_weight <= 0:
        raise ValueError("Varyant ağırlıkları toplamı 0'dan büyük olmalıdır")

    exp = ABExperiment(
        name=name.strip(),
        description=description.strip(),
        experiment_type=experiment_type,
        status="active",
        variants_json=json.dumps(cleaned_variants, ensure_ascii=False),
        target_metric=target_metric,
    )
    db.add(exp)
    db.commit()
    return get_experiment_by_id(db, exp.id)


def set_experiment_status(db, experiment_id: str, status: str) -> dict:
    if status not in ("active", "paused", "completed"):
        raise ValueError(f"Geçersiz deney durumu: {status}")
    exp = db.get(ABExperiment, experiment_id)
    if not exp:
        raise ValueError("Deney bulunamadı")
    exp.status = status
    exp.updated_at = now()
    db.commit()
    return get_experiment_by_id(db, exp.id)


# ============================================================================
# 3. OTURUM ATAMA VE CANLI ETKİLEŞİM (SESSION ASSIGNMENT & OUTCOME TRACKING)
# ============================================================================

def assign_conversation_variant(db, conversation_id: str) -> dict:
    """Görüşmeye aktif deneyden rastgele (ağırlıklı) bir varyant tahsis eder."""
    active_exp = db.scalars(
        select(ABExperiment)
        .where(ABExperiment.status == "active")
        .order_by(ABExperiment.created_at.desc())
    ).first()

    if not active_exp:
        return {
            "experiment_id": None,
            "variant_id": None,
            "prompt_template": "standard",
            "tts_seed": 9,
            "greeting_template": "standard",
        }

    try:
        variants = json.loads(active_exp.variants_json)
    except Exception:
        variants = []

    if not variants:
        return {
            "experiment_id": active_exp.id,
            "variant_id": "control",
            "prompt_template": "standard",
            "tts_seed": 9,
            "greeting_template": "standard",
        }

    # Mevcut kayıt var mı kontrolü (Idempotency)
    existing_assign = db.scalars(
        select(ABAssignment).where(ABAssignment.conversation_id == conversation_id)
    ).first()

    if existing_assign:
        matched = next(
            (v for v in variants if v.get("id") == existing_assign.variant_id), None
        )
        return {
            "experiment_id": existing_assign.experiment_id,
            "variant_id": existing_assign.variant_id,
            "prompt_template": matched.get("prompt_template", "standard") if matched else "standard",
            "tts_seed": int(matched.get("tts_seed", 9)) if matched else 9,
            "greeting_template": matched.get("greeting_template", "standard") if matched else "standard",
        }

    # Ağırlıklı rastgele seçim (Weighted random sampling)
    weights = [max(1, int(v.get("weight", 50))) for v in variants]
    chosen_variant = random.choices(variants, weights=weights, k=1)[0]

    assign = ABAssignment(
        conversation_id=conversation_id,
        experiment_id=active_exp.id,
        variant_id=chosen_variant.get("id", "control"),
        outcome="pending",
    )
    db.add(assign)
    db.commit()

    return {
        "experiment_id": active_exp.id,
        "variant_id": chosen_variant.get("id", "control"),
        "prompt_template": chosen_variant.get("prompt_template", "standard"),
        "tts_seed": int(chosen_variant.get("tts_seed", 9)),
        "greeting_template": chosen_variant.get("greeting_template", "standard"),
    }


def record_assignment_metrics(
    db,
    conversation_id: str,
    *,
    confirmed: bool,
    duration_seconds: float | None = None,
    turns_count: int = 0,
    first_audio_ms: float | None = None,
    tts_total_ms: float | None = None,
    llm_total_ms: float | None = None,
):
    """Görüşme tamamlandığında veya sonlandırıldığında A/B sonuçlarını günceller."""
    assign = db.scalars(
        select(ABAssignment).where(ABAssignment.conversation_id == conversation_id)
    ).first()
    if not assign:
        return None

    assign.outcome = "converted" if confirmed else "abandoned"
    if duration_seconds is not None:
        assign.duration_seconds = duration_seconds
    if turns_count > 0:
        assign.turns_count = turns_count
    if first_audio_ms is not None:
        assign.first_audio_ms = first_audio_ms
    if tts_total_ms is not None:
        assign.tts_total_ms = tts_total_ms
    if llm_total_ms is not None:
        assign.llm_total_ms = llm_total_ms
    assign.completed_at = now()
    db.commit()
    return assign


# ============================================================================
# 4. İSTATİSTİKSEL ANALİZ VE RAPORLAMA (STATISTICAL SIGNIFICANCE ENGINE)
# ============================================================================

def _compute_z_test(c_ctrl: int, n_ctrl: int, c_var: int, n_var: int) -> tuple[float, float]:
    """İki oranlı Z-Testi ve iki kuyruklu p-değeri hesabı."""
    if n_ctrl == 0 or n_var == 0:
        return 0.0, 1.0

    p_ctrl = c_ctrl / n_ctrl
    p_var = c_var / n_var

    # Havuzlanmış oran (Pooled proportion)
    p_pool = (c_ctrl + c_var) / (n_ctrl + n_var)
    if p_pool == 0 or p_pool == 1:
        return 0.0, 1.0

    se = math.sqrt(p_pool * (1 - p_pool) * (1 / n_ctrl + 1 / n_var))
    if se == 0:
        return 0.0, 1.0

    z_score = (p_var - p_ctrl) / se
    # İki kuyruklu p-değeri (math.erf kullanarak normal CDF)
    p_value = 1.0 - math.erf(abs(z_score) / math.sqrt(2))
    return round(z_score, 3), round(p_value, 4)


def get_experiment_report(db, experiment_id: str) -> dict:
    """Belirtilen deney için ayrıntılı varyant karşılaştırma ve istatistiksel anlamlılık raporu."""
    exp = db.get(ABExperiment, experiment_id)
    if not exp:
        raise ValueError("Deney bulunamadı")

    try:
        variants = json.loads(exp.variants_json)
    except Exception:
        variants = []

    variant_stats = []
    control_stats = None

    for idx, v in enumerate(variants):
        vid = v.get("id")
        assignments = db.scalars(
            select(ABAssignment).where(
                and_(
                    ABAssignment.experiment_id == exp.id,
                    ABAssignment.variant_id == vid,
                )
            )
        ).all()

        total = len(assignments)
        converted = sum(1 for a in assignments if a.outcome == "converted")
        abandoned = sum(1 for a in assignments if a.outcome == "abandoned")
        pending = sum(1 for a in assignments if a.outcome == "pending")

        c_rate = (converted / total) if total > 0 else 0.0

        # %95 Güven Aralığı (Wilson score veya Wald approksimasyonu)
        ci_half = (1.96 * math.sqrt(c_rate * (1 - c_rate) / total)) if total > 0 else 0.0
        ci_low = max(0.0, round((c_rate - ci_half) * 100, 1))
        ci_high = min(100.0, round((c_rate + ci_half) * 100, 1))

        # Metrik ortalamaları
        durs = [a.duration_seconds for a in assignments if a.duration_seconds is not None]
        audios = [a.first_audio_ms for a in assignments if a.first_audio_ms is not None]
        turns = [a.turns_count for a in assignments if a.turns_count > 0]

        avg_dur = round(sum(durs) / len(durs), 1) if durs else 0.0
        avg_audio = round(sum(audios) / len(audios), 1) if audios else 0.0
        avg_turns = round(sum(turns) / len(turns), 1) if turns else 0.0

        stat_item = {
            "variant_id": vid,
            "name": v.get("name", vid),
            "is_control": (idx == 0 or vid == "control"),
            "weight": v.get("weight", 50),
            "prompt_template": v.get("prompt_template", "standard"),
            "tts_seed": v.get("tts_seed", 9),
            "greeting_template": v.get("greeting_template", "standard"),
            "total_sessions": total,
            "converted_sessions": converted,
            "abandoned_sessions": abandoned,
            "pending_sessions": pending,
            "conversion_rate_pct": round(c_rate * 100, 1),
            "ci_95": [ci_low, ci_high],
            "avg_duration_sec": avg_dur,
            "avg_first_audio_ms": avg_audio,
            "avg_turns": avg_turns,
        }
        variant_stats.append(stat_item)
        if stat_item["is_control"]:
            control_stats = stat_item

    # Kontrol grubu referans alınarak Z-testi ve Karşılaştırma Analizi
    comparisons = []
    best_variant = None
    max_rate = -1.0

    if control_stats:
        for stat in variant_stats:
            if stat["is_control"]:
                continue
            z_val, p_val = _compute_z_test(
                control_stats["converted_sessions"],
                control_stats["total_sessions"],
                stat["converted_sessions"],
                stat["total_sessions"],
            )

            ctrl_pct = control_stats["conversion_rate_pct"]
            var_pct = stat["conversion_rate_pct"]
            lift_pct = round(((var_pct - ctrl_pct) / ctrl_pct * 100), 1) if ctrl_pct > 0 else 0.0

            is_significant = p_val < 0.05
            verdict = ""
            if is_significant:
                if lift_pct > 0:
                    verdict = f"{stat['name']} %{abs(lift_pct)} daha yüksek dönüşümle istatistiksel olarak üstün (p={p_val} < 0.05)."
                else:
                    verdict = f"{stat['name']} %{abs(lift_pct)} daha düşük dönüşüm sağladı; negatif etki tespit edildi (p={p_val} < 0.05)."
            elif stat["total_sessions"] < 30 or control_stats["total_sessions"] < 30:
                verdict = "Henüz yeterli örneklem toplanmadı (Önerilen: Varyant başına en az 30 görüşme)."
            else:
                verdict = f"Varyantlar arasında istatistiksel olarak anlamlı bir fark bulunamadı (p={p_val} ≥ 0.05)."

            comparisons.append({
                "variant_id": stat["variant_id"],
                "variant_name": stat["name"],
                "relative_lift_pct": lift_pct,
                "z_score": z_val,
                "p_value": p_val,
                "is_significant": is_significant,
                "confidence_level": "%95" if is_significant else ("%90" if p_val < 0.10 else "Yetersiz"),
                "verdict": verdict,
            })

    for stat in variant_stats:
        if stat["conversion_rate_pct"] > max_rate and stat["total_sessions"] > 0:
            max_rate = stat["conversion_rate_pct"]
            best_variant = stat["name"]

    return {
        "experiment_id": exp.id,
        "experiment_name": exp.name,
        "status": exp.status,
        "target_metric": exp.target_metric,
        "total_experiment_sessions": sum(s["total_sessions"] for s in variant_stats),
        "total_converted_sessions": sum(s["converted_sessions"] for s in variant_stats),
        "overall_conversion_pct": round(
            (sum(s["converted_sessions"] for s in variant_stats) / max(1, sum(s["total_sessions"] for s in variant_stats)) * 100),
            1,
        ),
        "best_performing_variant": best_variant or "Veri Bekleniyor",
        "variants": variant_stats,
        "comparisons": comparisons,
    }
````

## backend/acoustic_evaluation.py

````python
"""Gerçek ses çıktısından kalite ölçümü: TTS sesi STT ile geri tanınır.

WER/CER ve terim doğruluğu TTS ile STT'nin birleşik sonucudur; hata tek bir modele
atfedilemez. Ölçülemeyen metrikler None kalır, tahmini değer üretilmez:
- ABX için kurulu bir konuşmacı modeli yoktur.
- MOS için dinleyici testi veya standart bir ölçüm aracı yoktur.
- F0 sapması yalnızca onaylanmış taban kayda göre hesaplanır.
"""

from __future__ import annotations

import json
import re
from datetime import datetime, timezone
from pathlib import Path
from typing import Any, Dict, List, Optional, Tuple

import numpy as np

from backend.config import settings
from backend.normalizer_rules import BASE_AUTOMOTIVE_LEXICON
from backend.qa_telemetry_operator import abc_evaluator
from backend.text import normalize

REPORT_SCHEMA = 1
# Müşterinin telefonda duyduğu hat olduğu için kapı bu kanalın sonucunu kullanır.
GATE_CHANNEL = "telephony_8k"
CHANNELS = ("studio_48k", GATE_CHANNEL)


def report_dir() -> Path:
    return Path(settings.data_dir) / "acoustic"


def report_path() -> Path:
    return report_dir() / "latest.json"


def baseline_path() -> Path:
    return report_dir() / "baseline.json"


def canonical(text: str) -> str:
    """Karşılaştırma için Türkçe küçük harfe çevirir, noktalamayı kaldırır."""
    lowered = text.replace("İ", "i").replace("I", "ı").lower().replace("i̇", "i")
    return " ".join(re.sub(r"[^\w\s]", " ", lowered, flags=re.UNICODE).split())


def spoken_form(text: str) -> str:
    """Metni canlı normalizer'dan geçirir; rakam ve kısaltmalar okunuşa döner."""
    try:
        return canonical(normalize(text)["normalized"])
    except ValueError:
        return canonical(text)


def find_terms(raw_text: str) -> List[Tuple[str, str]]:
    """Cümledeki otomotiv terimlerini (kaynak, okunuş) olarak döndürür."""
    remaining = raw_text.lower()
    found = []
    for term in sorted(BASE_AUTOMOTIVE_LEXICON, key=len, reverse=True):
        pattern = r"(?<![\w-])" + re.escape(term) + r"(?![\w-])"
        for _ in re.findall(pattern, remaining):
            found.append((term, canonical(BASE_AUTOMOTIVE_LEXICON[term])))
        remaining = re.sub(pattern, " ", remaining)
    return found


def _contains_words(haystack: str, needle: str) -> bool:
    # STT Latin kısaltmayı büyük yazar: Türkçe küçültmede "TDI" "tdı" olur, "tdi" ile eşleşmez.
    folded = f" {haystack} ".replace("ı", "i")
    return bool(needle) and f" {needle.replace('ı', 'i')} " in folded


def split_glued_codes(text: str) -> str:
    """STT'nin bitişik yazdığı rakam ve harfleri ayırır: "2.0TDI" -> "2.0 TDI"."""
    return re.sub(r"(?<=\d)(?=[^\W\d_])|(?<=[^\W\d_])(?=\d)", " ", text)


def evaluate_transcript(raw_text: str, transcript: str) -> Dict[str, Any]:
    """Bir kanalın STT çıktısını beklenen okunuşla karşılaştırır."""
    separated = split_glued_codes(transcript)
    reference = spoken_form(raw_text)
    hypothesis = spoken_form(separated)
    errors = abc_evaluator.compute_wer_cer(reference, hypothesis)
    plain = canonical(separated)
    terms = find_terms(raw_text)
    missed = [
        term
        for term, spoken in terms
        if not (_contains_words(hypothesis, spoken) or _contains_words(plain, canonical(term)))
    ]
    return {
        "transcript": transcript,
        "wer": errors["wer"],
        "cer": errors["cer"],
        "terms_total": len(terms),
        "terms_correct": len(terms) - len(missed),
        "terms_missed": missed,
    }


def measure_f0(audio: np.ndarray, sample_rate: int) -> Optional[float]:
    """Sesli bölgelerin medyan F0 değeri (Hz); sesli bölge yoksa None."""
    import librosa

    f0, voiced, _ = librosa.pyin(
        np.asarray(audio, dtype=np.float32),
        fmin=80.0,
        fmax=450.0,
        sr=sample_rate,
        frame_length=1024,
    )
    values = f0[voiced & np.isfinite(f0)] if f0 is not None else np.array([])
    return round(float(np.median(values)), 2) if values.size else None


def _mean_pct(values: List[float]) -> Optional[float]:
    return round(float(np.mean(values)) * 100.0, 2) if values else None


def summarize_channel(rows: List[Dict[str, Any]], channel: str) -> Dict[str, Any]:
    """Başarısız sentez tam hata sayılır; sonuçtan çıkarılmaz."""
    results = [row["channels"].get(channel) for row in rows]
    wer = [r["wer"] if r else 1.0 for r in results]
    cer = [r["cer"] if r else 1.0 for r in results]
    total = sum(r["terms_total"] if r else len(find_terms(row["text"])) for r, row in zip(results, rows))
    correct = sum(r["terms_correct"] for r in results if r)
    missed: Dict[str, int] = {}
    for result in results:
        for term in result["terms_missed"] if result else []:
            missed[term] = missed.get(term, 0) + 1
    return {
        "sample_count": len(rows),
        "avg_wer_pct": _mean_pct(wer),
        "avg_cer_pct": _mean_pct(cer),
        "terms_total": total,
        "automotive_accuracy_pct": round(correct / total * 100.0, 2) if total else None,
        "terms_missed": dict(sorted(missed.items(), key=lambda item: -item[1])),
    }


def f0_drift_from_baseline(
    rows: List[Dict[str, Any]], baseline: Optional[Dict[str, Any]]
) -> Optional[float]:
    """Aynı cümlenin taban kayda göre en büyük F0 farkı; taban yoksa None."""
    if not baseline:
        return None
    reference = baseline.get("f0_by_id", {})
    drifts = [
        abs(row["f0_hz"] - reference[row["id"]])
        for row in rows
        if row.get("f0_hz") is not None and reference.get(row["id"]) is not None
    ]
    return round(max(drifts), 2) if drifts else None


def build_report(
    rows: List[Dict[str, Any]],
    baseline: Optional[Dict[str, Any]] = None,
    provenance: Optional[Dict[str, Any]] = None,
) -> Dict[str, Any]:
    f0_values = [row["f0_hz"] for row in rows if row.get("f0_hz") is not None]
    rtf_values = [row["rtf"] for row in rows if row.get("rtf") is not None]
    return {
        "schema": REPORT_SCHEMA,
        "measured_at": datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat(),
        "gate_channel": GATE_CHANNEL,
        "provenance": provenance or {},
        "sample_count": len(rows),
        "failed_synthesis": sum(1 for row in rows if row.get("error")),
        "channels": {channel: summarize_channel(rows, channel) for channel in CHANNELS},
        "tts": {
            "rtf_avg": round(float(np.mean(rtf_values)), 3) if rtf_values else None,
            "rtf_max": round(float(np.max(rtf_values)), 3) if rtf_values else None,
        },
        "f0": {
            "median_hz": round(float(np.median(f0_values)), 2) if f0_values else None,
            "min_hz": min(f0_values) if f0_values else None,
            "max_hz": max(f0_values) if f0_values else None,
            "baseline_measured_at": baseline.get("measured_at") if baseline else None,
            "max_drift_from_baseline_hz": f0_drift_from_baseline(rows, baseline),
        },
        "not_measured": {
            "speaker_embedding_abx": "Kurulu konuşmacı modeli yok",
            "avg_mos": "Dinleyici testi veya standart ölçüm aracı yok",
        },
        "rows": rows,
    }


def build_baseline(report: Dict[str, Any]) -> Dict[str, Any]:
    return {
        "measured_at": report["measured_at"],
        "f0_by_id": {row["id"]: row["f0_hz"] for row in report["rows"] if row.get("f0_hz") is not None},
    }


def _read_json(path: Path) -> Optional[Dict[str, Any]]:
    try:
        data = json.loads(path.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
    except (OSError, ValueError):
        return None
    return data if isinstance(data, dict) else None


def load_latest_report() -> Optional[Dict[str, Any]]:
    report = _read_json(report_path())
    return report if report and report.get("schema") == REPORT_SCHEMA else None


def load_baseline() -> Optional[Dict[str, Any]]:
    return _read_json(baseline_path())


def write_json(path: Path, data: Dict[str, Any]) -> None:
    path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    temporary = path.with_suffix(".tmp")
    temporary.write_text(json.dumps(data, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2), encoding="utf-8")
    temporary.replace(path)


def select_cases(cases: List[Dict[str, Any]], per_category: Optional[int]) -> List[Dict[str, Any]]:
    """Her kategoriden ilk N cümleyi seçer; None tüm cümleler demektir."""
    if per_category is None:
        return list(cases)
    counts: Dict[str, int] = {}
    selected = []
    for case in cases:
        counts[case["category"]] = counts.get(case["category"], 0) + 1
        if counts[case["category"]] <= per_category:
            selected.append(case)
    return selected
````

````python
"""
Asterisk Manager Interface (AMI) Client.

Giden cagrilar (outbound calls) baslatmak icin Asterisk AMI protokolunu (TCP 5038)
asenkron olarak yonetir. Testler ve yerel kullanim icin MockAMIClient sunar.
"""

from __future__ import annotations
import asyncio
import logging
from typing import Protocol, Optional, Dict, Any
from uuid import uuid4
from backend.config import settings

logger = logging.getLogger("automotive_voice.ami")


class AMIClientProtocol(Protocol):
    async def originate(
        self,
        channel: str,
        context: str,
        exten: str,
        callerid: str,
        variables: Optional[Dict[str, str]] = None,
        timeout_ms: int = 30000,
        action_id: Optional[str] = None,
    ) -> dict:
        """Asterisk Originate eylemi baslatir."""
        ...

    async def redirect(
        self,
        channel: str,
        context: str,
        exten: str,
        priority: int = 1,
        extra_channel: Optional[str] = None,
        action_id: Optional[str] = None,
    ) -> dict:
        """Aktif cagriyi baska bir dahiliye veya hedefe yonlendirir (Redirect/Transfer)."""
        ...

    async def setvar(
        self,
        channel: str,
        variable: str,
        value: str,
        action_id: Optional[str] = None,
    ) -> dict:
        """Cagri kanalina veya SIP basliklarina degisken yazar (Screen-Pop / Setvar)."""
        ...

    async def bridge(
        self,
        channel1: str,
        channel2: str,
        tone: bool = True,
        action_id: Optional[str] = None,
    ) -> dict:
        """Iki ayri ses kanalini birbirine baglar (Bridge)."""
        ...

    async def hangup(
        self,
        channel: str,
        cause: int = 16,
        action_id: Optional[str] = None,
    ) -> dict:
        """Cagriyi sonlandirir."""
        ...

    async def ping(self) -> bool:
        """AMI baglantisini test eder."""
        ...


class MockAMIClient:
    """Birim testler ve Asterisk baglantisi olmayan yerel calisma icin mock AMI client."""

    # Gerçek bir Asterisk'e bağlı değildir; çağrı/aktarım "yapıldı" diye raporlanmamalıdır.
    # Testler gerçek gibi davranan bir sahte istemci gerektiriyorsa bunu True yapabilir.
    is_real = False

    def __init__(self):
        self.calls: list[dict] = []
        self.redirects: list[dict] = []
        self.variables: list[dict] = []
        self.bridges: list[dict] = []
        self.hangups: list[dict] = []
        self.fail_next: bool = False
        self.fail_reason: str = "Asterisk AMI connection refused (127.0.0.1:5038)"

    async def originate(
        self,
        channel: str,
        context: str,
        exten: str,
        callerid: str,
        variables: Optional[Dict[str, str]] = None,
        timeout_ms: int = 30000,
        action_id: Optional[str] = None,
    ) -> dict:
        if self.fail_next:
            self.fail_next = False
            raise ConnectionError(self.fail_reason)
        act_id = action_id or f"ami-act-{uuid4().hex[:8]}"
        record = {
            "action_id": act_id,
            "channel": channel,
            "context": context,
            "exten": exten,
            "callerid": callerid,
            "variables": variables or {},
            "timeout_ms": timeout_ms,
            "response": "Success",
            "message": "Originate successfully queued",
        }
        self.calls.append(record)
        return record

    async def redirect(
        self,
        channel: str,
        context: str,
        exten: str,
        priority: int = 1,
        extra_channel: Optional[str] = None,
        action_id: Optional[str] = None,
    ) -> dict:
        if self.fail_next:
            self.fail_next = False
            raise ConnectionError(self.fail_reason)
        act_id = action_id or f"ami-redir-{uuid4().hex[:8]}"
        record = {
            "action_id": act_id,
            "channel": channel,
            "context": context,
            "exten": exten,
            "priority": priority,
            "extra_channel": extra_channel,
            "response": "Success",
            "message": "Redirect successfully queued",
        }
        self.redirects.append(record)
        return record

    async def setvar(
        self,
        channel: str,
        variable: str,
        value: str,
        action_id: Optional[str] = None,
    ) -> dict:
        if self.fail_next:
            self.fail_next = False
            raise ConnectionError(self.fail_reason)
        act_id = action_id or f"ami-setvar-{uuid4().hex[:8]}"
        record = {
            "action_id": act_id,
            "channel": channel,
            "variable": variable,
            "value": value,
            "response": "Success",
        }
        self.variables.append(record)
        return record

    async def bridge(
        self,
        channel1: str,
        channel2: str,
        tone: bool = True,
        action_id: Optional[str] = None,
    ) -> dict:
        if self.fail_next:
            self.fail_next = False
            raise ConnectionError(self.fail_reason)
        act_id = action_id or f"ami-bridge-{uuid4().hex[:8]}"
        record = {
            "action_id": act_id,
            "channel1": channel1,
            "channel2": channel2,
            "tone": tone,
            "response": "Success",
            "message": "Bridge successfully executed",
        }
        self.bridges.append(record)
        return record

    async def hangup(
        self,
        channel: str,
        cause: int = 16,
        action_id: Optional[str] = None,
    ) -> dict:
        if self.fail_next:
            self.fail_next = False
            raise ConnectionError(self.fail_reason)
        act_id = action_id or f"ami-hangup-{uuid4().hex[:8]}"
        record = {
            "action_id": act_id,
            "channel": channel,
            "cause": cause,
            "response": "Success",
            "message": "Channel hung up",
        }
        self.hangups.append(record)
        return record

    async def ping(self) -> bool:
        if self.fail_next:
            return False
        return True

    def clear(self):
        self.calls.clear()
        self.redirects.clear()
        self.variables.clear()
        self.bridges.clear()
        self.hangups.clear()
        self.fail_next = False


class AsteriskAMIClient:
    """Gercek TCP tabanli Asterisk Manager Interface (AMI) client."""

    is_real = True

    def __init__(
        self,
        host: str | None = None,
        port: int | None = None,
        username: str | None = None,
        secret: str | None = None,
    ):
        self.host = host or settings.ami_host
        self.port = port or settings.ami_port
        self.username = username or settings.ami_username
        self.secret = secret or settings.ami_secret

    async def _execute_action(
        self, action_dict: dict[str, Any], timeout: float = 10.0
    ) -> dict[str, str]:
        # Boş secret ile bağlantı kurulmaz (varsayılan parola yok).
        if not self.secret:
            raise PermissionError("AMI secret ayarlanmamış (AMI_SECRET)")
        reader, writer = await asyncio.wait_for(
            asyncio.open_connection(self.host, self.port), timeout=timeout
        )
        try:
            banner = await asyncio.wait_for(reader.readline(), timeout=timeout)
            if not banner.startswith(b"Asterisk Call Manager"):
                raise RuntimeError(
                    f"Gecersiz AMI basligi: {banner.decode(errors='ignore')}"
                )

            # Login
            login_payload = (
                f"Action: Login\r\n"
                f"Username: {self.username}\r\n"
                f"Secret: {self.secret}\r\n"
                f"ActionID: login-{uuid4().hex[:6]}\r\n\r\n"
            )
            writer.write(login_payload.encode("utf-8"))
            await writer.drain()

            login_resp = await self._read_response_block(reader, timeout=timeout)
            if login_resp.get("Response") != "Success":
                raise PermissionError(
                    f"AMI Giris basarisiz: {login_resp.get('Message', 'Unknown')}"
                )

            # Action
            lines = []
            for k, v in action_dict.items():
                if k == "Variable" and isinstance(v, dict):
                    for var_k, var_v in v.items():
                        lines.append(f"Variable: {var_k}={var_v}")
                else:
                    lines.append(f"{k}: {v}")
            lines.append("\r\n")
            writer.write("\r\n".join(lines).encode("utf-8"))
            await writer.drain()

            resp = await self._read_response_block(reader, timeout=timeout)
            return resp
        finally:
            writer.close()
            try:
                await writer.wait_closed()
            except Exception:
                pass

    async def _read_response_block(
        self, reader: asyncio.StreamReader, timeout: float = 10.0
    ) -> dict[str, str]:
        headers: dict[str, str] = {}
        while True:
            line_bytes = await asyncio.wait_for(reader.readline(), timeout=timeout)
            if not line_bytes:
                break
            line = line_bytes.decode("utf-8", errors="replace").strip()
            if not line:
                if headers:
                    break
                continue
            if ":" in line:
                k, v = line.split(":", 1)
                headers[k.strip()] = v.strip()
        return headers

    async def originate(
        self,
        channel: str,
        context: str,
        exten: str,
        callerid: str,
        variables: Optional[Dict[str, str]] = None,
        timeout_ms: int = 30000,
        action_id: Optional[str] = None,
    ) -> dict:
        act_id = action_id or f"ami-orig-{uuid4().hex[:8]}"
        payload = {
            "Action": "Originate",
            "Channel": channel,
            "Context": context,
            "Exten": exten,
            "Priority": "1",
            "Timeout": str(timeout_ms),
            "CallerID": callerid,
            "Async": "true",
            "ActionID": act_id,
        }
        if variables:
            payload["Variable"] = variables
        resp = await self._execute_action(payload)
        return {
            "action_id": act_id,
            "channel": channel,
            "response": resp.get("Response", "Error"),
            "message": resp.get("Message", ""),
        }

    async def redirect(
        self,
        channel: str,
        context: str,
        exten: str,
        priority: int = 1,
        extra_channel: Optional[str] = None,
        action_id: Optional[str] = None,
    ) -> dict:
        act_id = action_id or f"ami-redir-{uuid4().hex[:8]}"
        payload = {
            "Action": "Redirect",
            "Channel": channel,
            "Context": context,
            "Exten": exten,
            "Priority": str(priority),
            "ActionID": act_id,
        }
        if extra_channel:
            payload["ExtraChannel"] = extra_channel
        resp = await self._execute_action(payload)
        return {
            "action_id": act_id,
            "channel": channel,
            "response": resp.get("Response", "Error"),
            "message": resp.get("Message", ""),
        }

    async def setvar(
        self,
        channel: str,
        variable: str,
        value: str,
        action_id: Optional[str] = None,
    ) -> dict:
        act_id = action_id or f"ami-setvar-{uuid4().hex[:8]}"
        payload = {
            "Action": "Setvar",
            "Channel": channel,
            "Variable": variable,
            "Value": value,
            "ActionID": act_id,
        }
        resp = await self._execute_action(payload)
        return {
            "action_id": act_id,
            "channel": channel,
            "response": resp.get("Response", "Error"),
            "message": resp.get("Message", ""),
        }

    async def bridge(
        self,
        channel1: str,
        channel2: str,
        tone: bool = True,
        action_id: Optional[str] = None,
    ) -> dict:
        act_id = action_id or f"ami-bridge-{uuid4().hex[:8]}"
        payload = {
            "Action": "Bridge",
            "Channel1": channel1,
            "Channel2": channel2,
            "Tone": "yes" if tone else "no",
            "ActionID": act_id,
        }
        resp = await self._execute_action(payload)
        return {
            "action_id": act_id,
            "channel1": channel1,
            "channel2": channel2,
            "response": resp.get("Response", "Error"),
            "message": resp.get("Message", ""),
        }

    async def hangup(
        self,
        channel: str,
        cause: int = 16,
        action_id: Optional[str] = None,
    ) -> dict:
        act_id = action_id or f"ami-hangup-{uuid4().hex[:8]}"
        payload = {
            "Action": "Hangup",
            "Channel": channel,
            "Cause": str(cause),
            "ActionID": act_id,
        }
        resp = await self._execute_action(payload)
        return {
            "action_id": act_id,
            "channel": channel,
            "response": resp.get("Response", "Error"),
            "message": resp.get("Message", ""),
        }

    async def ping(self) -> bool:
        try:
            resp = await self._execute_action({"Action": "Ping"}, timeout=3.0)
            return resp.get("Response") == "Success"
        except Exception:
            return False


_default_mock_ami = MockAMIClient()
_custom_ami: AMIClientProtocol | None = None


def get_ami_client() -> AMIClientProtocol:
    global _custom_ami
    if _custom_ami is not None:
        return _custom_ami
    if getattr(settings, "ami_enabled", False) and settings.ami_secret:
        return AsteriskAMIClient()
    return _default_mock_ami


def set_ami_client(client: AMIClientProtocol | None) -> None:
    global _custom_ami
    _custom_ami = client


def is_real_ami() -> bool:
    """Etkin AMI istemcisi gerçek Asterisk'e bağlıysa True; MockAMIClient için False."""
    return bool(getattr(get_ami_client(), "is_real", False))
````

## backend/analytics.py

````python
"""Analytics, KPI calculations, and follow-up conversation management.

Telif Hakkı (c) 2026 Seydi Eryılmaz (@seydivakkas) - Tüm Hakları Saklıdır.
"""

from __future__ import annotations

import json
import logging
from collections import defaultdict
from datetime import datetime, timezone, timedelta
from typing import Any

from sqlalchemy import select
from backend.db import Conversation, Turn, Appointment, now

logger = logging.getLogger("automotive_voice.analytics")


def _calc_percentile(data: list[float], percentile: float) -> float | None:
    """Calculates the given percentile (0..100); no measurement yields None, never 0."""
    if not data:
        return None
    sorted_data = sorted(data)
    k = (len(sorted_data) - 1) * (percentile / 100.0)
    f = int(k)
    c = f + 1
    if c < len(sorted_data):
        return round(sorted_data[f] + (k - f) * (sorted_data[c] - sorted_data[f]), 1)
    return round(float(sorted_data[f]), 1)


def get_analytics_overview(db) -> dict[str, Any]:
    """Computes comprehensive analytics and KPIs across conversations, turns, and appointments."""
    now_utc = datetime.now(timezone.utc)

    # 1. Conversation Counts & Statuses
    conversations = db.scalars(select(Conversation)).all()
    total_conversations = len(conversations)

    status_counts = defaultdict(int)
    channel_counts = defaultdict(int)
    conv_timestamps: dict[str, list[datetime]] = defaultdict(list)

    for c in conversations:
        status_counts[c.status] += 1
        channel_counts[c.channel or "web"] += 1
        try:
            dt = datetime.fromisoformat(c.created_at)
            conv_timestamps[c.id].append(dt)
        except Exception:
            pass

    # 2. Appointment Counts & Conversion
    appointments = db.scalars(select(Appointment)).all()
    total_appointments = len(appointments)
    confirmed_appointments = sum(
        1 for a in appointments if a.confirmed and a.status == "confirmed"
    )
    cancelled_appointments = sum(1 for a in appointments if a.status == "cancelled")

    cancellation_rate = (
        round((cancelled_appointments / total_appointments) * 100, 1)
        if total_appointments > 0
        else 0.0
    )

    conversion_rate = (
        round((confirmed_appointments / total_conversations) * 100, 1)
        if total_conversations > 0
        else 0.0
    )

    # 3. Turns & Metric Latency Arrays
    turns = db.scalars(select(Turn).order_by(Turn.created_at)).all()
    total_turns = len(turns)

    user_turns_count = 0
    unclear_turns_count = 0
    barge_in_count = 0

    first_audio_list: list[float] = []
    llm_total_list: list[float] = []
    llm_first_token_list: list[float] = []
    stt_list: list[float] = []
    tts_list: list[float] = []
    rtf_list: list[float] = []

    for t in turns:
        try:
            dt = datetime.fromisoformat(t.created_at)
            conv_timestamps[t.conversation_id].append(dt)
        except Exception:
            pass

        if t.role == "user":
            user_turns_count += 1
        elif t.role == "assistant":
            # Check for clarification / unclear response
            text_lower = (t.text or "").lower()
            if any(
                phrase in text_lower
                for phrase in [
                    "anlayamadım",
                    "tekrar edebilir misiniz",
                    "tekrar söyleyebilir misiniz",
                    "net duyamadım",
                    "doğrulayamadım",
                ]
            ):
                unclear_turns_count += 1

        # Parse metrics
        if t.metrics and t.metrics != "{}":
            try:
                m = json.loads(t.metrics) if isinstance(t.metrics, str) else t.metrics
                if isinstance(m, dict):
                    if "first_audio_ms" in m and m["first_audio_ms"] is not None:
                        first_audio_list.append(float(m["first_audio_ms"]))
                    if "llm_total_ms" in m and m["llm_total_ms"] is not None:
                        llm_total_list.append(float(m["llm_total_ms"]))
                    if "llm_first_token_ms" in m and m["llm_first_token_ms"] is not None:
                        llm_first_token_list.append(float(m["llm_first_token_ms"]))
                    if "stt_ms" in m and m["stt_ms"] is not None:
                        stt_list.append(float(m["stt_ms"]))
                    if "tts_ms" in m and m["tts_ms"] is not None:
                        tts_list.append(float(m["tts_ms"]))
                    if "rtf" in m and m["rtf"] is not None:
                        rtf_list.append(float(m["rtf"]))
                    if "barge_in_signal_ms" in m and m["barge_in_signal_ms"] is not None:
                        barge_in_count += 1
            except Exception:
                pass

    # STT Accuracy / Clarity rate
    clarity_rate = (
        round(100.0 - (unclear_turns_count / max(user_turns_count, 1) * 100.0), 1)
        if user_turns_count > 0
        else None
    )

    # Average Conversation Duration (seconds)
    durations = []
    for cid, dts in conv_timestamps.items():
        if len(dts) >= 2:
            dur = (max(dts) - min(dts)).total_seconds()
            if 0 < dur < 3600:  # Ignore anomalies > 1 hour
                durations.append(dur)
    avg_duration_sec = round(sum(durations) / len(durations), 1) if durations else None

    # 4. Latency KPI Summary Dict (ölçüm yoksa None; sahte sıfır üretilmez)
    latency_kpis = {
        "first_audio_ms": {
            "avg": round(sum(first_audio_list) / len(first_audio_list), 1)
            if first_audio_list
            else None,
            "min": round(min(first_audio_list), 1) if first_audio_list else None,
            "max": round(max(first_audio_list), 1) if first_audio_list else None,
            "p50": _calc_percentile(first_audio_list, 50),
            "p95": _calc_percentile(first_audio_list, 95),
            "sample_count": len(first_audio_list),
        },
        "llm_ms": {
            "avg_total": round(sum(llm_total_list) / len(llm_total_list), 1)
            if llm_total_list
            else None,
            "p50_total": _calc_percentile(llm_total_list, 50),
            "p95_total": _calc_percentile(llm_total_list, 95),
            "avg_first_token": round(
                sum(llm_first_token_list) / len(llm_first_token_list), 1
            )
            if llm_first_token_list
            else None,
            "p50_first_token": _calc_percentile(llm_first_token_list, 50),
            "p95_first_token": _calc_percentile(llm_first_token_list, 95),
            "sample_count": len(llm_total_list),
        },
        "stt_ms": {
            "avg": round(sum(stt_list) / len(stt_list), 1) if stt_list else None,
            "p50": _calc_percentile(stt_list, 50),
            "p95": _calc_percentile(stt_list, 95),
            "sample_count": len(stt_list),
        },
        "tts_ms": {
            "avg": round(sum(tts_list) / len(tts_list), 1) if tts_list else None,
            "avg_rtf": round(sum(rtf_list) / len(rtf_list), 3) if rtf_list else None,
            "sample_count": len(tts_list),
        },
        "barge_in_count": barge_in_count,
    }

    # 5. Daily Trend (Last 14 Days)
    daily_stats: dict[str, dict[str, int]] = {}
    for i in range(13, -1, -1):
        day_str = (now_utc - timedelta(days=i)).strftime("%Y-%m-%d")
        daily_stats[day_str] = {"date": day_str, "appointments": 0, "conversations": 0}

    for a in appointments:
        day = (a.created_at or "")[:10]
        if day in daily_stats:
            daily_stats[day]["appointments"] += 1

    for c in conversations:
        day = (c.created_at or "")[:10]
        if day in daily_stats:
            daily_stats[day]["conversations"] += 1

    daily_trend = list(daily_stats.values())

    # 6. Hourly Call Distribution (00..23)
    hourly_distribution = [0] * 24
    for c in conversations:
        try:
            dt = datetime.fromisoformat(c.created_at)
            hourly_distribution[dt.hour] += 1
        except Exception:
            pass

    return {
        "summary": {
            "total_conversations": total_conversations,
            "completed_conversations": status_counts.get("completed", 0),
            "follow_up_conversations": status_counts.get("follow_up", 0),
            "resolved_conversations": status_counts.get("resolved", 0),
            "active_conversations": status_counts.get("active", 0),
            "total_appointments": total_appointments,
            "confirmed_appointments": confirmed_appointments,
            "cancelled_appointments": cancelled_appointments,
            "cancellation_rate_pct": cancellation_rate,
            "conversion_rate_pct": conversion_rate,
            "avg_turns_per_conversation": (
                round(total_turns / total_conversations, 1) if total_conversations else None
            ),
            "avg_duration_seconds": avg_duration_sec,
            "stt_clarity_rate_pct": clarity_rate,
            "stt_unclear_count": unclear_turns_count,
            "channels": dict(channel_counts),
        },
        "latency_kpis": latency_kpis,
        "daily_trend": daily_trend,
        "hourly_distribution": hourly_distribution,
    }


def get_follow_up_conversations(db, status_filter: str = "all", limit: int = 50) -> list[dict[str, Any]]:
    """Returns conversations that require operator follow-up or were resolved."""
    query = select(Conversation)
    if status_filter == "follow_up":
        query = query.where(Conversation.status == "follow_up")
    elif status_filter == "resolved":
        query = query.where(Conversation.status == "resolved")
    elif status_filter == "pending_all":
        query = query.where(Conversation.status.in_(["follow_up", "active"]))

    query = query.order_by(Conversation.created_at.desc()).limit(limit)
    conversations = db.scalars(query).all()

    items = []
    for c in conversations:
        # Get turns for this conversation
        turns = db.scalars(
            select(Turn)
            .where(Turn.conversation_id == c.id)
            .order_by(Turn.created_at)
        ).all()

        last_user_text = ""
        last_assistant_text = ""
        duration_sec = 0.0

        if turns:
            try:
                t0 = datetime.fromisoformat(turns[0].created_at)
                t1 = datetime.fromisoformat(turns[-1].created_at)
                duration_sec = max(0.0, round((t1 - t0).total_seconds(), 1))
            except Exception:
                pass

            for t in reversed(turns):
                if not last_user_text and t.role == "user":
                    last_user_text = t.text
                if not last_assistant_text and t.role == "assistant":
                    last_assistant_text = t.text
                if last_user_text and last_assistant_text:
                    break

        items.append(
            {
                "id": c.id,
                "channel": c.channel,
                "status": c.status,
                "operator_notes": c.operator_notes or "",
                "resolved_at": c.resolved_at,
                "created_at": c.created_at,
                "turn_count": len(turns),
                "duration_seconds": duration_sec,
                "last_user_text": last_user_text,
                "last_assistant_text": last_assistant_text,
            }
        )

    return items


def resolve_conversation(
    db, conversation_id: str, operator_notes: str = ""
) -> Conversation:
    """Marks a conversation as resolved by an operator with notes."""
    c = db.get(Conversation, conversation_id)
    if not c:
        raise ValueError("Görüşme bulunamadı")
    c.status = "resolved"
    c.operator_notes = operator_notes
    c.resolved_at = now()
    db.commit()
    return c


def reopen_conversation(db, conversation_id: str) -> Conversation:
    """Reopens a resolved conversation back to follow_up status."""
    c = db.get(Conversation, conversation_id)
    if not c:
        raise ValueError("Görüşme bulunamadı")
    c.status = "follow_up"
    c.resolved_at = None
    c.follow_up_at = now()
    db.commit()
    return c


UNCLEAR_PATTERNS = [
    "anlayamadım",
    "tekrar edebilir misiniz",
    "tekrar söyleyebilir misiniz",
    "net duyamadım",
    "doğrulayamadım",
    "tam duyamadım",
]


def get_unclear_conversations(db, limit: int = 50) -> list[dict[str, Any]]:
    """Returns conversations where the assistant asked for clarification or misrecognition occurred."""
    from backend.config import settings

    # Fetch recent conversations
    conversations = db.scalars(
        select(Conversation)
        .order_by(Conversation.created_at.desc())
        .limit(limit * 3)
    ).all()

    unclear_list = []
    for c in conversations:
        turns = db.scalars(
            select(Turn)
            .where(Turn.conversation_id == c.id)
            .order_by(Turn.created_at)
        ).all()

        unclear_turns = []
        turn_items = []
        for t in turns:
            text_lower = (t.text or "").lower()
            is_unclear = t.role == "assistant" and any(p in text_lower for p in UNCLEAR_PATTERNS)
            if is_unclear:
                unclear_turns.append(t.text)
            turn_items.append({
                "id": t.id,
                "role": t.role,
                "text": t.text,
                "metrics": t.metrics,
                "created_at": t.created_at,
                "is_unclear": is_unclear,
            })

        # Include if has unclear turns or status is follow_up
        if unclear_turns or c.status == "follow_up":
            rec_path = settings.data_dir / "recordings" / f"{c.id}.wav"
            unclear_list.append({
                "id": c.id,
                "status": c.status,
                "channel": c.channel or "voice",
                "created_at": c.created_at,
                "operator_notes": c.operator_notes or "",
                "resolved_at": c.resolved_at,
                "turn_count": len(turns),
                "unclear_count": len(unclear_turns),
                "unclear_phrases": unclear_turns,
                "has_recording": rec_path.exists(),
                "turns": turn_items,
            })
            if len(unclear_list) >= limit:
                break

    return unclear_list
````

````python
"""
ÖZEL LİSANS — TÜM HAKLAR SAKLIDIR

Telif Hakkı (c) 2026 Seydi Eryılmaz (@seydivakkas)

Bu yazılım ve ilgili tüm dosyalar ("Yazılım") yalnızca görüntüleme ve eğitim
amaçlı olarak paylaşılmıştır.

YASAKLAR:
  1. Kopyalanamaz, çoğaltılamaz, dağıtılamaz veya yeniden yayınlanamaz.
  2. Ticari veya ticari olmayan hiçbir projede kullanılamaz, değiştirilemez.
  3. Alt lisanslanamaz, satılamaz veya devredilemez.
  4. Tersine mühendislik yapılamaz.

İZİN VERİLEN KULLANIM:
  - GitHub üzerinde görüntüleme ve okuma.
  - Kişisel öğrenim amacıyla kodu inceleme (kopyalamadan).

YAZARIN AÇIK YAZILI İZNİ OLMAKSIZIN HİÇBİR KULLANIM HAKKI TANINMAZ.
İzin talepleri için: GitHub @seydivakkas
"""

from __future__ import annotations

import hashlib
import hmac
import io
import logging
import uuid
from dataclasses import asdict, dataclass
from datetime import datetime, timedelta, timezone
from enum import Enum
from pathlib import Path
from typing import Any, Dict, List, Optional, Tuple, Union

import numpy as np
import soundfile as sf
from sqlalchemy import select
from sqlalchemy.orm import Session

from backend.config import settings
from backend.db import AudioArchive

logger = logging.getLogger("audio_archive_compliance")

DEFAULT_ARCHIVE_DIR = settings.data_dir / "audio_archives"
DEFAULT_RETENTION_YEARS = 2
DEFAULT_RETENTION_DAYS = 730


class ArchiveKeyMissingError(RuntimeError):
    """Arşiv HMAC anahtarı (AUDIO_ARCHIVE_MASTER_KEY) ayarlı değil; işlem güvenli şekilde reddedilir."""


class ArchiveCodec(str, Enum):
    OPUS = "opus"
    GSM_FR = "gsm_fr"
    RAW_WAV = "raw_wav"


@dataclass
class ArchiveResult:
    archive_id: str
    conversation_id: Optional[str]
    call_session_id: str
    caller_phone: str
    codec: str
    channels: int
    sample_rate: int
    duration_sec: float
    raw_size_bytes: int
    compressed_size_bytes: int
    compression_ratio_percent: float
    space_saved_bytes: int
    raw_sha256: str
    archive_sha256: str
    hmac_signature: str
    file_path: str
    retention_years: int
    created_at: str
    expires_at: str
    is_redacted: bool
    status: str

    def to_dict(self) -> Dict[str, Any]:
        return asdict(self)


@dataclass
class VerificationResult:
    archive_id: str
    is_valid: bool
    expected_sha256: str
    actual_sha256: str
    hmac_valid: bool
    file_exists: bool
    status: str
    checked_at: str
    details: str

    def to_dict(self) -> Dict[str, Any]:
        return asdict(self)


def compute_sha256(data: bytes) -> str:
    """Verilen bayt dizisinin SHA-256 özetini (hex) hesaplar."""
    return hashlib.sha256(data).hexdigest()


def compute_hmac_sha256(data_hash: str, key: str) -> str:
    """SHA-256 özetini kurumsal anahtar ile mühürleyerek tahrifat denetim imzası üretir."""
    if not key:
        raise ArchiveKeyMissingError("AUDIO_ARCHIVE_MASTER_KEY ayarlanmamış")
    return hmac.new(key.encode("utf-8"), data_hash.encode("utf-8"), hashlib.sha256).hexdigest()


def calculate_retention_expiry(
    created_at: Optional[Union[datetime, str]] = None,
    years: int = DEFAULT_RETENTION_YEARS,
) -> str:
    """Yasal saklama mevzuatına göre (varsayılan 2 yıl / 730 gün) imha tarihini hesaplar."""
    if created_at is None:
        base_dt = datetime.now(timezone.utc)
    elif isinstance(created_at, str):
        try:
            base_dt = datetime.fromisoformat(created_at)
        except Exception:
            base_dt = datetime.now(timezone.utc)
    else:
        base_dt = created_at

    expiry_dt = base_dt + timedelta(days=years * 365)
    return expiry_dt.isoformat()


def align_stereo_channels(
    caller_wave: np.ndarray,
    assistant_wave: np.ndarray,
) -> np.ndarray:
    """
    Gelen müşteri sesini sol kanala, asistan Leyla sesini sağ kanala senkronize eder.
    Kısa kalan kanalı sıfırlarla doldurarak (zero-padding) eşitler.
    Çıktı shape: (N, 2)
    """
    c_len = len(caller_wave)
    a_len = len(assistant_wave)
    max_len = max(c_len, a_len)

    if max_len == 0:
        return np.zeros((0, 2), dtype=np.float32)

    left = np.zeros(max_len, dtype=np.float32)
    right = np.zeros(max_len, dtype=np.float32)

    left[:c_len] = caller_wave
    right[:a_len] = assistant_wave

    return np.column_stack([left, right])


class AudioArchiveComplianceEngine:
    """
    Yasal Saklama, GSM-FR / OPUS Sıkıştırma ve SHA-256 / HMAC Bütünlük Denetçisi.
    - 8 kHz ham telefon kayıtlarını OPUS (16 kbps) veya GSM-FR (GSM 6.10) ile sıkıştırır (%85-93 tasarruf).
    - Her arşiv için ham ses ve sıkıştırılmış sesin SHA-256 özetini ve HMAC mührünü çıkarır.
    - 2 yıllık (730 gün) yasal saklama mevzuatını denetler, süresi dolan kayıtları tasfiye eder.
    - Mono ve Çift Kanallı Stereo (Sol: Müşteri, Sağ: Leyla) arşivlemeyi destekler.
    """

    def __init__(
        self,
        archive_dir: Optional[Union[str, Path]] = None,
        master_key: Optional[str] = None,
        default_codec: str = "opus",
    ):
        self.archive_dir = Path(archive_dir) if archive_dir else DEFAULT_ARCHIVE_DIR
        self.archive_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
        self._master_key = master_key
        self.default_codec = default_codec

    @property
    def master_key(self) -> str:
        """Açıkça verilen anahtar, yoksa ayardaki anahtar; ikisi de boşsa hata verir."""
        key = self._master_key if self._master_key is not None else settings.audio_archive_master_key
        if not key:
            raise ArchiveKeyMissingError("AUDIO_ARCHIVE_MASTER_KEY ayarlanmamış")
        return key

    def compress_audio(
        self,
        audio: np.ndarray,
        sample_rate: int = 8000,
        codec: str = "opus",
    ) -> Tuple[bytes, str]:
        """
        Ham numpy dalga formunu (mono veya stereo) hedef formata sıkıştırır.
        Döndürür: (compressed_bytes, file_extension)
        """
        c = codec.lower().strip()
        buf = io.BytesIO()

        if c == "opus":
            # OGG container içinde 16 kbps ses optimizasyonlu OPUS
            # soundfile OGG / OPUS mono veya stereo kabul eder
            sf.write(buf, audio, sample_rate, format="OGG", subtype="OPUS")
            ext = ".ogg"
        elif c in ("gsm", "gsm_fr", "gsm610"):
            # GSM 6.10 Full-Rate: Sadece Mono ve 8000 Hz desteklenir
            mono_audio = audio[:, 0] if audio.ndim > 1 else audio
            sf.write(buf, mono_audio, 8000, format="WAV", subtype="GSM610")
            ext = ".gsm.wav"
        else:
            # Fallback standart PCM_16 WAV
            sf.write(buf, audio, sample_rate, format="WAV", subtype="PCM_16")
            ext = ".wav"

        compressed_data = buf.getvalue()
        return compressed_data, ext

    def decompress_audio(
        self,
        compressed_bytes: bytes,
    ) -> Tuple[np.ndarray, int]:
        """Sıkıştırılmış arşiv baytlarını okuyarak (waveform, sample_rate) döner."""
        buf = io.BytesIO(compressed_bytes)
        data, sr = sf.read(buf)
        return data.astype(np.float32), sr

    def archive_call_session(
        self,
        *,
        audio: Optional[Union[np.ndarray, bytes]] = None,
        sample_rate: int = 8000,
        conversation_id: Optional[str] = None,
        call_session_id: str = "",
        caller_phone: str = "",
        codec: Optional[str] = None,
        is_redacted: bool = False,
        retention_years: int = DEFAULT_RETENTION_YEARS,
        db: Optional[Session] = None,
        caller_channel: Optional[np.ndarray] = None,
        assistant_channel: Optional[np.ndarray] = None,
    ) -> ArchiveResult:
        """
        Bir çağrının sesini sıkıştırır, SHA-256 ve HMAC mührünü oluşturur,
        fiziksel diske ve SQLite veritabanına yasal saklama uyumlu olarak kaydeder.
        """
        master_key = self.master_key  # Anahtar yoksa dosya yazılmadan önce hata verir.
        active_codec = codec or self.default_codec
        now_dt = datetime.now(timezone.utc)
        created_at_str = now_dt.isoformat()
        expires_at_str = calculate_retention_expiry(now_dt, years=retention_years)
        archive_id = f"arch-{uuid.uuid4().hex[:12]}"

        # 1. Ses dalga formunu hazırla
        if caller_channel is not None and assistant_channel is not None:
            # İki kanallı senkronize stereo arşiv
            waveform = align_stereo_channels(caller_channel, assistant_channel)
            channels = 2
        elif audio is not None:
            if isinstance(audio, bytes):
                # Ham S16LE PCM baytları
                arr = np.frombuffer(audio, dtype=np.int16).astype(np.float32) / 32768.0
                waveform = arr
                channels = 1
            else:
                waveform = audio.astype(np.float32)
                channels = waveform.shape[1] if waveform.ndim > 1 else 1
        else:
            raise ValueError("Arşivlenecek ses verisi (audio veya kanallar) belirtilmelidir.")

        # 2. Ham ses boyutu ve SHA-256
        # Ham S16LE eşdeğer bayt boyutu: samples * channels * 2
        total_samples = len(waveform)
        raw_size_bytes = total_samples * channels * 2
        raw_bytes_representation = np.clip(waveform * 32767.0, -32768, 32767).astype(np.int16).tobytes()
        raw_sha256 = compute_sha256(raw_bytes_representation)
        duration_sec = round(float(total_samples) / float(sample_rate), 3) if sample_rate > 0 else 0.0

        # 3. Sıkıştırma (OPUS / GSM-FR)
        compressed_bytes, ext = self.compress_audio(waveform, sample_rate=sample_rate, codec=active_codec)
        compressed_size_bytes = len(compressed_bytes)

        # Sıkıştırma tasarruf oranı
        if raw_size_bytes > 0:
            compression_ratio_pct = round(
                (1.0 - (compressed_size_bytes / raw_size_bytes)) * 100.0, 2
            )
            space_saved_bytes = max(0, raw_size_bytes - compressed_size_bytes)
        else:
            compression_ratio_pct = 0.0
            space_saved_bytes = 0

        # 4. Kriptografik Özet ve HMAC Mührü
        archive_sha256 = compute_sha256(compressed_bytes)
        hmac_sig = compute_hmac_sha256(archive_sha256, master_key)

        # 5. Dosyayı Yıl-Ay alt dizinine kaydet (Partitioning)
        month_dir = self.archive_dir / now_dt.strftime("%Y-%m")
        month_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
        filename = f"{archive_id}_{now_dt.strftime('%Y%m%d_%H%M%S')}{ext}"
        target_path = month_dir / filename
        target_path.write_bytes(compressed_bytes)

        # 6. Veritabanına kaydet
        if db is not None:
            archive_record = AudioArchive(
                id=archive_id,
                conversation_id=conversation_id,
                call_session_id=call_session_id or f"sess-{archive_id}",
                caller_phone=caller_phone,
                codec=active_codec,
                channels=channels,
                sample_rate=sample_rate,
                duration_sec=duration_sec,
                raw_size_bytes=raw_size_bytes,
                compressed_size_bytes=compressed_size_bytes,
                compression_ratio_percent=compression_ratio_pct,
                sha256_hash=archive_sha256,
                raw_sha256_hash=raw_sha256,
                hmac_signature=hmac_sig,
                file_path=str(target_path).replace("\\", "/"),
                retention_years=retention_years,
                expires_at=expires_at_str,
                is_redacted=is_redacted,
                status="active",
                created_at=created_at_str,
            )
            db.add(archive_record)
            db.commit()

        logger.info(
            "Ses Arşivi Oluşturuldu: %s | Codec: %s | Orijinal: %d B -> Sıkıştırılmış: %d B (Tasarruf: %%%.1f) | SHA256: %s",
            archive_id,
            active_codec,
            raw_size_bytes,
            compressed_size_bytes,
            compression_ratio_pct,
            archive_sha256[:12],
        )

        return ArchiveResult(
            archive_id=archive_id,
            conversation_id=conversation_id,
            call_session_id=call_session_id,
            caller_phone=caller_phone,
            codec=active_codec,
            channels=channels,
            sample_rate=sample_rate,
            duration_sec=duration_sec,
            raw_size_bytes=raw_size_bytes,
            compressed_size_bytes=compressed_size_bytes,
            compression_ratio_percent=compression_ratio_pct,
            space_saved_bytes=space_saved_bytes,
            raw_sha256=raw_sha256,
            archive_sha256=archive_sha256,
            hmac_signature=hmac_sig,
            file_path=str(target_path).replace("\\", "/"),
            retention_years=retention_years,
            created_at=created_at_str,
            expires_at=expires_at_str,
            is_redacted=is_redacted,
            status="active",
        )

    def verify_archive_integrity(
        self,
        archive_id: str,
        db: Optional[Session] = None,
        file_path: Optional[Union[str, Path]] = None,
        expected_sha256: Optional[str] = None,
        expected_hmac: Optional[str] = None,
    ) -> VerificationResult:
        """
        Fiziksel dosyanın SHA-256 ve HMAC mührünü yeniden hesaplayarak tahrifat denetimi yapar.
        Eğer dosya baytları değiştirilmişse veya imza uyuşmuyorsa 'tampered' uyarısı verir.
        """
        master_key = self.master_key  # Anahtar yoksa doğrulama asla başarılı dönmez.
        checked_at = datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat()
        target_path: Optional[Path] = None
        exp_sha = expected_sha256
        exp_hmac = expected_hmac
        db_record: Optional[AudioArchive] = None

        if db is not None:
            db_record = db.get(AudioArchive, archive_id)
            if db_record:
                target_path = Path(db_record.file_path)
                exp_sha = db_record.sha256_hash
                exp_hmac = db_record.hmac_signature

        if target_path is None and file_path:
            target_path = Path(file_path)

        if target_path is None or not target_path.exists():
            return VerificationResult(
                archive_id=archive_id,
                is_valid=False,
                expected_sha256=exp_sha or "",
                actual_sha256="",
                hmac_valid=False,
                file_exists=False,
                status="missing",
                checked_at=checked_at,
                details="Arşiv dosyası disk üzerinde bulunamadı.",
            )

        # Dosyayı oku ve SHA-256 hesapla
        file_bytes = target_path.read_bytes()
        actual_sha = compute_sha256(file_bytes)
        calculated_hmac = compute_hmac_sha256(actual_sha, master_key)

        # Beklenen özet veya imza yoksa doğrulama başarılı sayılmaz (fail closed).
        sha_matches = bool(exp_sha) and hmac.compare_digest(actual_sha, exp_sha)
        hmac_matches = bool(exp_hmac) and hmac.compare_digest(calculated_hmac, exp_hmac)
        is_valid = sha_matches and hmac_matches

        if is_valid:
            status = "verified"
            details = "Kriptografik bütünlük doğrulandı (SHA-256 ve HMAC geçerli)."
        elif not exp_sha or not exp_hmac:
            status = "unverifiable"
            details = "Beklenen SHA-256 veya HMAC kaydı yok; bütünlük doğrulanamadı."
        else:
            status = "tampered"
            details = f"Tahrifat tespit edildi! Beklenen SHA: {exp_sha}, Mevcut: {actual_sha}"

        if db_record is not None and db is not None and status != "unverifiable":
            db_record.status = status
            db.commit()

        return VerificationResult(
            archive_id=archive_id,
            is_valid=is_valid,
            expected_sha256=exp_sha or "",
            actual_sha256=actual_sha,
            hmac_valid=hmac_matches,
            file_exists=True,
            status=status,
            checked_at=checked_at,
            details=details,
        )

    def audit_retention_compliance(
        self,
        db: Session,
        target_date: Optional[datetime] = None,
    ) -> Dict[str, Any]:
        """
        Veritabanındaki tüm ses arşivlerinin 2 yıllık yasal saklama durumunu denetler.
        Süresi dolan, dolmak üzere olan ve aktif arşivleri kategorize eder.
        """
        now_dt = target_date or datetime.now(timezone.utc)
        thirty_days_later = (now_dt + timedelta(days=30)).isoformat()
        now_iso = now_dt.isoformat()

        records = list(db.scalars(select(AudioArchive)).all())

        total_count = len(records)
        active_count = 0
        expiring_soon_count = 0
        expired_count = 0
        purged_count = 0

        total_raw_bytes = 0
        total_compressed_bytes = 0

        expired_list = []
        expiring_soon_list = []

        for r in records:
            total_raw_bytes += r.raw_size_bytes
            total_compressed_bytes += r.compressed_size_bytes

            if r.status == "purged":
                purged_count += 1
                continue

            exp = r.expires_at or ""
            if exp and exp <= now_iso:
                expired_count += 1
                expired_list.append(
                    {"id": r.id, "file_path": r.file_path, "expires_at": exp, "duration_sec": r.duration_sec}
                )
            elif exp and exp <= thirty_days_later:
                expiring_soon_count += 1
                expiring_soon_list.append(
                    {"id": r.id, "file_path": r.file_path, "expires_at": exp, "duration_sec": r.duration_sec}
                )
            else:
                active_count += 1

        total_saved_bytes = max(0, total_raw_bytes - total_compressed_bytes)
        overall_ratio = (
            round((total_saved_bytes / total_raw_bytes) * 100.0, 2)
            if total_raw_bytes > 0
            else 0.0
        )

        return {
            "audited_at": now_iso,
            "total_records": total_count,
            "active_count": active_count,
            "expiring_soon_count": expiring_soon_count,
            "expired_count": expired_count,
            "purged_count": purged_count,
            "total_raw_megabytes": round(total_raw_bytes / (1024 * 1024), 2),
            "total_compressed_megabytes": round(total_compressed_bytes / (1024 * 1024), 2),
            "total_saved_megabytes": round(total_saved_bytes / (1024 * 1024), 2),
            "overall_space_saved_percent": overall_ratio,
            "expired_archives": expired_list,
            "expiring_soon_archives": expiring_soon_list,
        }

    def purge_expired_archives(
        self,
        db: Session,
        dry_run: bool = True,
        target_date: Optional[datetime] = None,
    ) -> Dict[str, Any]:
        """
        2 yıllık yasal saklama süresi dolan kayıtları tasfiye eder.
        dry_run=False ise fiziksel dosyayı diskten siler ve veritabanı kaydını
        'purged' statüsüne geçirerek kriptografik tombstone (SHA-256 izi) bırakır.
        """
        real_now = datetime.now(timezone.utc)
        now_dt = target_date or real_now
        if now_dt.tzinfo is None:
            now_dt = now_dt.replace(tzinfo=timezone.utc)
        # Gelecek tarih yasal saklama süresini atlatabilir; gerçek zamana indirilir.
        if now_dt > real_now:
            now_dt = real_now
        now_iso = now_dt.isoformat()

        stmt = select(AudioArchive).where(
            AudioArchive.expires_at <= now_iso,
            AudioArchive.status != "purged",
        )
        candidates = list(db.scalars(stmt).all())

        purged_ids: List[str] = []
        failed_ids: List[str] = []
        freed_bytes = 0

        for r in candidates:
            if not dry_run:
                # Fiziksel dosyayı sil; yalnızca silindiyse veya zaten yoksa purged işaretle
                try:
                    p = Path(r.file_path)
                    if p.exists():
                        p.unlink()
                except Exception as e:
                    logger.warning("Tasfiye edilecek dosya silinemedi: %s (%s)", r.file_path, e)
                    failed_ids.append(r.id)
                    continue

                # Durumu güncelle (kriptografik iz kalır)
                r.status = "purged"

            freed_bytes += r.compressed_size_bytes
            purged_ids.append(r.id)

        if not dry_run and candidates:
            db.commit()

        return {
            "dry_run": dry_run,
            "purged_count": len(purged_ids),
            "purged_archive_ids": purged_ids,
            "failed_archive_ids": failed_ids,
            "freed_megabytes": round(freed_bytes / (1024 * 1024), 3),
            "executed_at": now_iso,
        }


# Global Singleton Instance
audio_archive_engine = AudioArchiveComplianceEngine()
````
