````python
                "inputSchema": {
                    "type": "object",
                    "properties": {},
                },
            },
            {
                "name": "ontology_resolve_vehicle",
                "description": "Kullanıcının doğal dilde söylediği araç marka/modelini sertifikalı otomotiv ontolojisiyle eşler.",
                "inputSchema": {
                    "type": "object",
                    "properties": {
                        "user_text": {
                            "type": "string",
                            "description": "Kullanıcının sesli söylediği araç ifadesi (örn: 'golf 7 1.4 tsi', 'megan 4').",
                        }
                    },
                    "required": ["user_text"],
                },
            },
            {
                "name": "ontology_diagnose_fault",
                "description": "Araç göstergesindeki ikaz lambası veya mekanik arıza belirtisinden standart OBD-II kodunu ve önerilen paketi bulur.",
                "inputSchema": {
                    "type": "object",
                    "properties": {
                        "symptom_or_code": {
                            "type": "string",
                            "description": "Arıza belirtisi veya OBD kodu (örn: 'motor arıza lambası sarı yanıyor', 'P0300', 'hava yastığı').",
                        }
                    },
                    "required": ["symptom_or_code"],
                },
            },
            {
                "name": "ontology_validate_action",
                "description": "AI ajanının veritabanında gerçekleştirmek istediği randevu veya fiyatlama işlemini ontoloji kurallarıyla doğrular.",
                "inputSchema": {
                    "type": "object",
                    "properties": {
                        "action_type": {
                            "type": "string",
                            "description": "İşlem tipi: 'create_booking', 'reschedule_booking', 'quote_price'.",
                        },
                        "payload": {
                            "type": "object",
                            "description": "İşlem parametreleri (customer_name, customer_phone, vehicle_model, slot_id vb.).",
                        },
                    },
                    "required": ["action_type", "payload"],
                },
            },
        ]

    @classmethod
    def execute_tool(cls, tool_name: str, arguments: Dict[str, Any]) -> Dict[str, Any]:
        """
        Gelen MCP araç çağrısını deterministik olarak icra eder.
        """
        if tool_name == "ontology_get_schema_summary":
            graph = DatabaseIntrospector.introspect_schema()
            return {
                "version": graph.version,
                "table_count": graph.table_count,
                "concept_count": graph.concept_count,
                "tables": [n.name for n in graph.nodes if n.type == "table"],
                "relationships_count": len(graph.edges),
            }

        elif tool_name == "ontology_get_service_packages":
            pkgs = AutomotiveGroundingEngine.get_service_packages()
            return {"packages": [p.model_dump() for p in pkgs]}

        elif tool_name == "ontology_resolve_vehicle":
            text = arguments.get("user_text", "")
            resolved = AutomotiveGroundingEngine.resolve_vehicle(text)
            if resolved:
                return {"found": True, "vehicle": resolved.model_dump()}
            return {"found": False, "message": f"'{text}' ifadesi standart katalogla eşleştirilemedi."}

        elif tool_name == "ontology_diagnose_fault":
            symptom = arguments.get("symptom_or_code", "")
            faults = AutomotiveGroundingEngine.diagnose_symptom(symptom)
            return {"count": len(faults), "matches": [f.model_dump() for f in faults]}

        elif tool_name == "ontology_validate_action":
            action_type = arguments.get("action_type", "")
            payload = arguments.get("payload", {})
            req = OntologyValidationRequest(action_type=action_type, payload=payload)
            res = AutomotiveGroundingEngine.validate_action(req)
            return res.model_dump()

        else:
            raise ValueError(f"Bilinmeyen MCP aracı: {tool_name}")
````

## backend/ontology/models.py

````python
"""
FreyaTTS Automotive Cockpit — Automotive Ontology Data Models
Telif Hakkı (c) 2026 Seydi Eryılmaz (@seydivakkas) — ÖZEL LİSANS / TÜM HAKLAR SAKLIDIR

NVIDIA Auto-Ontology mimarisinden esinlenilmiş semantik kavram, ilişki ve
iş kuralı veri sözleşmeleri.
"""

from __future__ import annotations

from enum import Enum
from typing import Any, Dict, List, Optional
from pydantic import BaseModel, Field


class OntologyNodeType(str, Enum):
    TABLE = "table"
    CONCEPT = "concept"
    METRIC = "metric"
    RULE = "rule"


class RelationType(str, Enum):
    FOREIGN_KEY = "foreign_key"
    OWNS = "owns"
    HAS_FAULT = "has_fault"
    REQUIRES_PACKAGE = "requires_package"
    ASSIGNED_TO = "assigned_to"
    DEFINES_PRICE = "defines_price"
    VALIDATES_WITH = "validates_with"
    CONSTRAINED_BY = "constrained_by"


class OntologyNode(BaseModel):
    id: str
    name: str
    type: OntologyNodeType
    domain: str = "automotive"
    description: str
    properties: Dict[str, Any] = Field(default_factory=dict)
    is_certified: bool = True


class OntologyEdge(BaseModel):
    source: str
    target: str
    relation: RelationType
    description: str = ""
    is_required: bool = False


class OntologySchemaGraph(BaseModel):
    version: str = "1.0.0"
    generated_at: str
    database_type: str = "sqlite"
    table_count: int
    concept_count: int
    nodes: List[OntologyNode]
    edges: List[OntologyEdge]


class VehicleConcept(BaseModel):
    brand: str
    model: str
    submodel: Optional[str] = None
    engine_type: str = "Benzin/Dizel"
    year_range: str = "2010–2025"
    segment: str = "C"
    normalized_name: str
    aliases: List[str] = Field(default_factory=list)


class ServicePackageConcept(BaseModel):
    package_id: str
    name: str
    price_tl: int
    duration_min: int
    description: str
    included_checks: List[str]
    recommended_for: List[str]


class DiagnosticSeverity(str, Enum):
    INFO = "info"
    LOW = "low"
    MEDIUM = "medium"
    HIGH = "high"
    CRITICAL = "critical"


class DiagnosticFaultConcept(BaseModel):
    obd_code: str
    system: str
    warning_light: str
    severity: DiagnosticSeverity
    description: str
    common_symptoms: List[str]
    suggested_action: str
    recommended_package_id: str


class OntologyValidationRequest(BaseModel):
    action_type: str  # e.g., "create_booking", "reschedule_booking", "quote_price", "diagnose_fault"
    payload: Dict[str, Any]
    strict_mode: bool = True


class OntologyValidationResult(BaseModel):
    valid: bool
    action_type: str
    errors: List[str] = Field(default_factory=list)
    warnings: List[str] = Field(default_factory=list)
    certified_payload: Dict[str, Any] = Field(default_factory=dict)
    policy_reference: str = "Freya-Auto-Ontology-v1"
````

## backend/ontology/router.py

````python
"""
FreyaTTS Automotive Cockpit — Ontology REST API Endpoints
Telif Hakkı (c) 2026 Seydi Eryılmaz (@seydivakkas) — ÖZEL LİSANS / TÜM HAKLAR SAKLIDIR
"""

from __future__ import annotations

from typing import Any, Dict, List
from fastapi import APIRouter, Depends, HTTPException, Query
from backend.deps import auth
from backend.ontology.grounding import (
    CERTIFIED_DIAGNOSTIC_FAULTS,
    CERTIFIED_VEHICLE_CATALOG,
    AutomotiveGroundingEngine,
)
from backend.ontology.introspector import DatabaseIntrospector
from backend.ontology.mcp_server import AutomotiveOntologyMCPAdapter
from backend.ontology.models import (
    DiagnosticFaultConcept,
    OntologySchemaGraph,
    OntologyValidationRequest,
    OntologyValidationResult,
    ServicePackageConcept,
    VehicleConcept,
)

router = APIRouter(prefix="/api/ontology", tags=["Automotive Ontology"], dependencies=[Depends(auth)])


@router.get("/schema", response_model=OntologySchemaGraph)
def get_ontology_schema() -> OntologySchemaGraph:
    """
    Veritabanı şemasını ve semantik iş kavramlarını graf yapısında döner (Discover adımı).
    """
    return DatabaseIntrospector.introspect_schema()


@router.get("/packages", response_model=List[ServicePackageConcept])
def get_certified_packages() -> List[ServicePackageConcept]:
    """
    Sertifikalı ekspertiz paketleri ve fiyatlandırma sözleşmesini döner (Single Source of Truth).
    """
    return AutomotiveGroundingEngine.get_service_packages()


@router.get("/diagnostics", response_model=List[DiagnosticFaultConcept])
def get_certified_diagnostics(
    query: str = Query(default="", description="Arıza kodu veya semptom filtresi")
) -> List[DiagnosticFaultConcept]:
    """
    Sertifikalı OBD-II arıza kodları ve ikaz lambası ontolojisini döner.
    """
    if query:
        return AutomotiveGroundingEngine.diagnose_symptom(query)
    return list(CERTIFIED_DIAGNOSTIC_FAULTS.values())


@router.get("/vehicles", response_model=List[VehicleConcept])
def get_certified_vehicles() -> List[VehicleConcept]:
    """
    Katalogdaki standart referans araç modellerini döner.
    """
    return CERTIFIED_VEHICLE_CATALOG


@router.post("/resolve-vehicle")
def resolve_vehicle(body: Dict[str, str]) -> Dict[str, Any]:
    """
    Doğal dille söylenmiş araç metnini sertifikalı araç ontolojisine eşler.
    """
    user_text = body.get("user_text", "")
    if not user_text:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=400, detail="'user_text' parametresi zorunludur.")
    res = AutomotiveGroundingEngine.resolve_vehicle(user_text)
    if res:
        return {"matched": True, "vehicle": res.model_dump()}
    return {"matched": False, "message": "Eşleşen standart araç modeli bulunamadı."}


@router.post("/validate-action", response_model=OntologyValidationResult)
def validate_action(req: OntologyValidationRequest) -> OntologyValidationResult:
    """
    Agent veya Supervisor tarafından planlanan veritabanı eylemini ontoloji kurallarıyla doğrular (Guardrail).
    """
    return AutomotiveGroundingEngine.validate_action(req)


@router.get("/mcp/tools")
def get_mcp_tools() -> Dict[str, Any]:
    """
    NVIDIA Auto-Ontology standardına uygun MCP araç şemalarını listeler.
    """
    return {"tools": AutomotiveOntologyMCPAdapter.get_tool_definitions()}


@router.post("/mcp/execute")
def execute_mcp_tool(body: Dict[str, Any]) -> Dict[str, Any]:
    """
    MCP üzerinden gelen araç çağrısını güvenli bir şekilde yürütür.
    """
    tool_name = body.get("name")
    arguments = body.get("arguments", {})
    if not tool_name:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=400, detail="'name' alanı zorunludur.")
    try:
        result = AutomotiveOntologyMCPAdapter.execute_tool(tool_name, arguments)
        return {"status": "success", "result": result}
    except Exception as e:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=400, detail=str(e))
````

## backend/operator_inbox.py

````python
"""Read-only operator work list from recorded follow-up and transfer states."""

from datetime import datetime, time, timedelta, timezone
from zoneinfo import ZoneInfo

from sqlalchemy import and_, case, func, literal, or_, select, union_all

from backend.config import settings
from backend.db import Conversation, OperatorTransfer

PENDING_TRANSFER = ("initiated", "whispering")
OPEN_FOLLOW_UP = ("callback", "booking_pending", "booking_unknown")
LEGACY_CALLBACK = "] Operatör aktarımı yapılamadı (AMI bağlı değil); müşteri geri aranacak."
ISTANBUL = ZoneInfo("Europe/Istanbul")


def today_view(db, *, now: datetime, period: str, category: str, limit: int, offset: int) -> dict:
    cutoff = now - timedelta(seconds=settings.operator_whisper_timeout_sec)
    within_deadline = func.julianday(OperatorTransfer.created_at) > func.julianday(cutoff.isoformat())
    if settings.demo_mode:
        within_deadline = or_(within_deadline, OperatorTransfer.id.startswith("demo_", autoescape=True))
    pending_transfer = and_(OperatorTransfer.status.in_(PENDING_TRANSFER), within_deadline)
    transfer_rows = select(
        OperatorTransfer.id.label("id"),
        OperatorTransfer.conversation_id.label("conversation_id"),
        literal("transfer").label("kind"),
        OperatorTransfer.status.label("status"),
        OperatorTransfer.created_at.label("since"),
        literal("transfer").label("since_source"),
    ).outerjoin(Conversation, OperatorTransfer.conversation_id == Conversation.id).where(
        pending_transfer,
        or_(OperatorTransfer.conversation_id.is_(None), Conversation.status.not_in(("purged", "resolved"))),
    )
    legacy_callback = Conversation.follow_up_kind.is_(None) & Conversation.operator_notes.contains(
        LEGACY_CALLBACK, autoescape=True,
    )
    follow_up_rows = select(
        Conversation.id.label("id"),
        Conversation.id.label("conversation_id"),
        case(
            (Conversation.follow_up_kind.in_(OPEN_FOLLOW_UP), Conversation.follow_up_kind),
            (legacy_callback, "callback"),
            else_="follow_up",
        ).label("kind"),
        Conversation.status.label("status"),
        func.coalesce(Conversation.follow_up_at, Conversation.created_at).label("since"),
        case((Conversation.follow_up_at.is_not(None), "follow_up"), else_="conversation").label("since_source"),
    ).where(
        Conversation.status == "follow_up",
        ~select(OperatorTransfer.id).where(
            OperatorTransfer.conversation_id == Conversation.id, pending_transfer,
        ).exists(),
    )
    items = union_all(transfer_rows, follow_up_rows).subquery()
    local_day = now.astimezone(ISTANBUL).date()
    start = datetime.combine(local_day, time.min, ISTANBUL)
    tomorrow = start + timedelta(days=1)
    since = func.julianday(items.c.since)
    bucket = case(
        (since < func.julianday(start.isoformat()), "carryover"),
        (since < func.julianday(tomorrow.isoformat()), "today"),
        else_="unknown",
    ).label("period")
    priority = case(
        (items.c.kind == "transfer", 0), (items.c.kind == "callback", 1),
        (items.c.kind == "booking_unknown", 2), (items.c.kind == "booking_pending", 3),
        else_=4,
    )
    counts = dict(db.execute(select(items.c.kind, func.count()).group_by(items.c.kind)).all())
    query = select(items, bucket)
    if period != "all":
        query = query.where(bucket == period)
    if category == "booking":
        query = query.where(items.c.kind.in_(("booking_pending", "booking_unknown")))
    elif category != "all":
        query = query.where(items.c.kind == category)
    total = db.scalar(select(func.count()).select_from(query.subquery()))
    rows = []
    query = query.order_by(priority, since.asc().nulls_last(), items.c.id).limit(limit).offset(offset)
    for row in db.execute(query).mappings():
        item = dict(row)
        try:
            timestamp = datetime.fromisoformat(item["since"])
            if timestamp.utcoffset() is None:
                timestamp = timestamp.replace(tzinfo=timezone.utc)
            item["age_seconds"] = max(0, int((now - timestamp).total_seconds()))
        except (TypeError, ValueError):
            item["age_seconds"] = None
        rows.append(item)
    return {"local_date": local_day.isoformat(), "counts": counts, "total": total, "items": rows}
````

## backend/outbound.py

````python
"""
Giden Cagri (Outbound Call) Servisi.

Asterisk AMI uzerinden randevu teyit ve hatirlatma aramalari baslatir,
sonuclari (teyit, iptal, ulasilamadi) OutboundCall tablosunda ve randevu
kaydinda atomik olarak gunceller.
"""

from __future__ import annotations
import logging
from sqlalchemy import select
from backend.config import settings
from backend.db import OutboundCall, Appointment, cancel_appointment, now
from backend.ami import get_ami_client, is_real_ami

logger = logging.getLogger("automotive_voice.outbound")


async def initiate_outbound_call(
    db,
    *,
    appointment_id: str,
    phone: str | None = None,
    call_type: str = "reminder",
) -> OutboundCall:
    """
    Belirtilen randevu icin Asterisk AMI uzerinden giden arama baslatir.
    Arama kaydini olusturur ve durumu 'in-progress' olarak gunceller.
    """
    app = db.get(Appointment, appointment_id)
    if not app:
        raise ValueError("Randevu bulunamadı")
    if app.status == "cancelled":
        raise ValueError("İptal edilmiş randevu için teyit araması başlatılamaz")

    # Hedef telefon numarasi
    target_phone = (phone or "").strip()
    if not target_phone:
        target_phone = app.customer.strip()
    if not target_phone:
        raise ValueError("Arama için geçerli bir telefon numarası gerekli")

    # Ayni randevu icin aktif arama kontrolu
    existing_active = (
        db.scalars(
            select(OutboundCall)
            .where(OutboundCall.appointment_id == appointment_id)
            .where(OutboundCall.status.in_(("originating", "in-progress")))
        )
        .first()
    )
    if existing_active:
        raise ValueError("Bu randevu için halihazırda devam eden bir arama mevcut")

    # Asterisk Kanal formatı (örn: PJSIP/05321234567@trunk veya Local/9092@from-internal)
    clean_digits = "".join(c for c in target_phone if c.isdigit())
    dial_str = clean_digits if len(clean_digits) >= 7 else target_phone
    channel = f"{settings.ami_channel_prefix}/{dial_str}@{settings.ami_trunk}"

    call_record = OutboundCall(
        appointment_id=appointment_id,
        phone=target_phone,
        customer=app.customer,
        call_type=call_type,
        status="originating",
        outcome="pending",
    )
    db.add(call_record)
    db.flush()

    ami = get_ami_client()
    variables = {
        "APPOINTMENT_ID": str(app.id),
        "CALL_ID": str(call_record.id),
        "OUTBOUND_UUID": str(call_record.id),
        "CALL_TYPE": call_type,
        "CUSTOMER": app.customer,
    }

    try:
        call_record.attempts += 1
        res = await ami.originate(
            channel=channel,
            context=settings.ami_context,
            exten=settings.ami_exten,
            callerid=settings.ami_callerid,
            variables=variables,
            timeout_ms=30000,
        )
        call_record.action_id = res.get("action_id", "")
        # Mock AMI gerçek arama başlatmaz; "in-progress" denirse operatör yanılır.
        call_record.status = "in-progress" if is_real_ami() else "simulated"
        call_record.last_error = None
    except Exception as e:
        logger.error("AMI Originate basarisiz: %s", e)
        call_record.status = "failed"
        call_record.last_error = str(e)
        db.commit()
        raise RuntimeError(f"Giden arama başlatılamadı: {e}")

    db.commit()
    return call_record


def get_outbound_session_context(db, call_uuid: str) -> dict | None:
    """AudioSocket UUID'si bir OutboundCall.id ile eşleşiyorsa oturum bağlamını döner.

    Eşleşme için Asterisk giden diyaloğu AudioSocket'i `${OUTBOUND_UUID}` ile açmalıdır
    (backend `OUTBOUND_UUID` değişkenini AMI/call-file ile zaten gönderir). Gelen çağrıların
    rastgele UUID'si hiçbir kayda uymaz ve None döner.
    """
    call = db.get(OutboundCall, str(call_uuid))
    if not call:
        return None
    mode = "outbound_diagnostic" if call.call_type == "diagnostic_alert" else "outbound_reminder"
    return {"mode": mode, "appointment_id": call.appointment_id, "call_id": call.id}


def complete_outbound_call(
    db,
    *,
    call_id: str,
    outcome: str,
    notes: str = "",
) -> OutboundCall:
    """
    Arama sonucunu ('confirmed', 'cancelled', 'unreachable') kaydeder.
    Musteri iptal ettiyse randevuyu otomatik iptal eder ve saati bosa cikarir.
    """
    valid_outcomes = ("confirmed", "cancelled", "unreachable")
    if outcome not in valid_outcomes:
        raise ValueError(f"Geçersiz arama sonucu. Beklenen: {valid_outcomes}")

    call = db.get(OutboundCall, call_id)
    if not call:
        raise ValueError("Arama kaydı bulunamadı")

    call.outcome = outcome
    call.status = "completed"
    call.completed_at = now()

    app = db.get(Appointment, call.appointment_id)
    if app:
        if outcome == "cancelled":
            # Kurumsal ücret varsa iade de burada (tek paylaşımlı işlev) yapılır.
            cancel_appointment(db, app, commit=False)
            logger.info("Randevu (%s) giden arama teyidinde iptal edildi.", app.id)
        elif outcome == "confirmed":
            app.status = "confirmed"
            logger.info("Randevu (%s) giden arama teyidinde onaylandi.", app.id)

    db.commit()
    return call


def cancel_outbound_call(db, call_id: str) -> OutboundCall:
    """Bekleyen veya baslatilmakta olan aramayi iptal eder."""
    call = db.get(OutboundCall, call_id)
    if not call:
        raise ValueError("Arama kaydı bulunamadı")
    if call.status in ("completed", "cancelled"):
        return call
    call.status = "cancelled"
    call.outcome = "cancelled"
    call.completed_at = now()
    db.commit()
    return call


def get_outbound_stats(db) -> dict:
    """Giden arama istatistiklerini doner."""
    calls = db.scalars(select(OutboundCall)).all()
    return {
        "total": len(calls),
        "in_progress": len([c for c in calls if c.status == "in-progress"]),
        "simulated": len([c for c in calls if c.status == "simulated"]),
        "confirmed": len([c for c in calls if c.outcome == "confirmed"]),
        "cancelled": len([c for c in calls if c.outcome == "cancelled"]),
        "unreachable": len([c for c in calls if c.outcome == "unreachable"]),
        "failed": len([c for c in calls if c.status == "failed"]),
    }
````

## backend/outbound_dialer.py

````python
"""
ÖZEL LİSANS — TÜM HAKLAR SAKLIDIR

Telif Hakkı (c) 2026 Seydi Eryılmaz (@seydivakkas)

Bu yazılım ve ilgili tüm dosyalar ("Yazılım") yalnızca görüntüleme ve eğitim
amaçlı olarak paylaşılmıştır.

YASAKLAR:
  1. Kopyalanamaz, çoğaltılamaz, dağıtılamaz veya yeniden yayınlanamaz.
  2. Ticari veya ticari olmayan hiçbir projede kullanılamaz, değiştirilemez.
  3. Alt lisanslanamaz, satılamaz veya devredilemez.
  4. Tersine mühendislik yapılamaz.

İZİN VERİLEN KULLANIM:
  - GitHub üzerinde görüntüleme ve okuma.
  - Kişisel öğrenim amacıyla kodu inceleme (kopyalamadan).

YAZARIN AÇIK YAZILI İZNİ OLMAKSIZIN HİÇBİR KULLANIM HAKKI TANINMAZ.
İzin talepleri için: GitHub @seydivakkas
"""

from __future__ import annotations

from dataclasses import dataclass, field
import logging
import os
from pathlib import Path
import time
from typing import Any, Literal
from uuid import uuid4

import numpy as np
from sqlalchemy import select

from backend.config import settings
from backend.db import OutboundCall, Appointment, Vehicle, now
from backend.ami import get_ami_client


def _ami_is_real(ami) -> bool:
    """backend.ami.is_real_ami() ile aynı kural, ama verilen istemci üzerinde: Mock AMI gerçek arama başlatmaz."""
    return bool(getattr(ami, "is_real", True))

logger = logging.getLogger("outbound_dialer")

# Varsayılan Dizinler
DEFAULT_SPOOL_BASE_DIR = settings.data_dir / "call_spool"
DEFAULT_OUTGOING_DIR = DEFAULT_SPOOL_BASE_DIR / "outgoing"
DEFAULT_TMP_DIR = DEFAULT_SPOOL_BASE_DIR / "tmp"

# AMD Eşikleri (Türkçe Telephony)
MAX_HUMAN_GREETING_SEC = 1.6   # Türkçe 'Alo/Efendim/Buyrun' genelde < 1.5s sürer
MIN_HUMAN_PAUSE_SEC = 0.35     # Selamlamadan sonra karşı tarafı dinleme sessizliği
MIN_MACHINE_GREETING_SEC = 2.0 # Telesekreter anonsu kesintisiz > 2s sürer
BEEP_DETECT_FREQ_HZ = 1000.0   # Standart telesekreter bip frekansı (800-1200 Hz)


@dataclass
class AMDResult:
    """Türkçe AMD (Answering Machine Detection) Karar Nesnesi."""
    classification: Literal["HUMAN", "MACHINE", "UNKNOWN"]
    confidence: float
    greeting_duration_sec: float
    silence_duration_sec: float
    beep_detected: bool
    reason: str
    analyzed_at: float = field(default_factory=time.monotonic)

    def to_dict(self) -> dict[str, Any]:
        return {
            "classification": self.classification,
            "confidence": round(self.confidence, 3),
            "greeting_duration_sec": round(self.greeting_duration_sec, 3),
            "silence_duration_sec": round(self.silence_duration_sec, 3),
            "beep_detected": self.beep_detected,
            "reason": self.reason,
        }


def detect_voicemail_beep(
    samples: np.ndarray,
    sample_rate: int = 8000,
    target_freq: float = BEEP_DETECT_FREQ_HZ,
    tolerance_hz: float = 150.0,
    min_duration_ms: float = 150.0,
) -> bool:
    """
    Telesekreter bip sesini (800-1200 Hz saf ton) frekans enerjisi analiziyle yakalar.
    Sinyalin hedef frekanstaki tepe enerjisinin ortalama spektruma oranını kontrol eder.
    """
    if len(samples) < int(sample_rate * (min_duration_ms / 1000.0)):
        return False

    # 100 ms'lik pencerelerle FFT veya Goertzel gücü hesapla
    window_size = int(sample_rate * 0.10)  # 100 ms
    hop_size = window_size // 2

    freqs = np.fft.rfftfreq(window_size, 1.0 / sample_rate)
    target_mask = (freqs >= (target_freq - tolerance_hz)) & (freqs <= (target_freq + tolerance_hz))

    consecutive_beep_windows = 0
    required_windows = int(min_duration_ms / 50.0)

    for i in range(0, len(samples) - window_size + 1, hop_size):
        chunk = samples[i : i + window_size]
        # Hanning penceresi uygula
        windowed = chunk * np.hanning(len(chunk))
        spectrum = np.abs(np.fft.rfft(windowed))
        total_energy = np.sum(spectrum ** 2) + 1e-9
        beep_energy = np.sum(spectrum[target_mask] ** 2)

        # Eğer bip aralığındaki enerji toplam enerjinin %35'inden fazlaysa ve seviye yeterliyse
        energy_ratio = beep_energy / total_energy
        rms = np.sqrt(np.mean(chunk ** 2))

        if energy_ratio >= 0.35 and rms >= 0.05:
            consecutive_beep_windows += 1
            if consecutive_beep_windows >= required_windows:
                return True
        else:
            consecutive_beep_windows = 0

    return False


def detect_turkish_amd(
    audio_bytes_or_samples: bytes | np.ndarray,
    sample_rate: int = 8000,
    energy_threshold: float = 0.02,
) -> AMDResult:
    """
    Gelen ses üzerinde Türkçe AMD (İnsan vs Telesekreter) analizi uygular:
    - Alo/Efendim gibi kısa Türkçe karşılama (< 1.6s) ve ardından sessizlik -> HUMAN (< 1 saniyede kesinleşir).
    - Uzun anons (> 2.0s) ve ardından 1000 Hz bip sesi -> MACHINE.
    """
    if isinstance(audio_bytes_or_samples, bytes):
        if len(audio_bytes_or_samples) % 2:
            audio_bytes_or_samples = audio_bytes_or_samples[:-1]
        samples = np.frombuffer(audio_bytes_or_samples, dtype="<i2").astype(np.float32) / 32768.0
    else:
        samples = audio_bytes_or_samples

    total_duration = len(samples) / sample_rate
    if total_duration < 0.2:
        return AMDResult(
            classification="UNKNOWN",
            confidence=0.5,
            greeting_duration_sec=total_duration,
            silence_duration_sec=0.0,
            beep_detected=False,
            reason="Analiz için yetersiz ses süresi (< 200 ms)",
        )

    # 20 ms'lik çerçevelerle konuşma / sessizlik segmentasyonu
    frame_len = int(sample_rate * 0.02)
    energies = []
    for i in range(0, len(samples) - frame_len + 1, frame_len):
        chunk = samples[i : i + frame_len]
        energies.append(float(np.sqrt(np.mean(chunk ** 2))))

    # Konuşma çerçeveleri tespiti
    voiced_frames = [e >= energy_threshold for e in energies]
    first_voice_idx = next((i for i, v in enumerate(voiced_frames) if v), None)

    if first_voice_idx is None:
        # Tamamen sessiz hat
        return AMDResult(
            classification="UNKNOWN",
            confidence=0.6,
            greeting_duration_sec=0.0,
            silence_duration_sec=total_duration,
            beep_detected=False,
            reason="Hatta hiç ses algılanmadı (Sessizlik)",
        )

    # İlk konuşma bloğunun süresi ve ardından gelen sessizlik
    greeting_frames = 0
    silence_after_frames = 0
    passed_greeting = False

    for v in voiced_frames[first_voice_idx:]:
        if v and not passed_greeting:
            greeting_frames += 1
        elif not v and not passed_greeting:
            # 200 ms sessizlik olursa konuşma bitti kabul et
            silence_after_frames += 1
            if silence_after_frames >= 10:  # 200 ms
                passed_greeting = True
        elif passed_greeting and not v:
            silence_after_frames += 1

    greeting_sec = greeting_frames * 0.02
    silence_after_sec = silence_after_frames * 0.02

    # Bip sesi kontrolü
    beep_found = detect_voicemail_beep(samples, sample_rate=sample_rate)

    # 1. Kural: Bip sesi varsa kesinlikle telesekreter
    if beep_found:
        return AMDResult(
            classification="MACHINE",
            confidence=0.98,
            greeting_duration_sec=greeting_sec,
            silence_duration_sec=silence_after_sec,
            beep_detected=True,
            reason="Telesekreter bip sesi (1000 Hz) ve uzun anons algılandı.",
        )

    # 2. Kural: Konuşma süresi çok uzunsa (> 2.0 saniye kesintisiz anons) -> MACHINE
    if greeting_sec >= MIN_MACHINE_GREETING_SEC:
        return AMDResult(
            classification="MACHINE",
            confidence=0.92,
            greeting_duration_sec=greeting_sec,
            silence_duration_sec=silence_after_sec,
            beep_detected=False,
            reason=f"Uzun kesintisiz telesekreter anonsu algılandı ({greeting_sec:.2f}s > 2.0s).",
        )

    # 3. Kural: Kısa Türkçe selamlama (Alo/Efendim <= 1.6s) ve ardından dinleme sessizliği -> HUMAN
    if greeting_sec <= MAX_HUMAN_GREETING_SEC and silence_after_sec >= MIN_HUMAN_PAUSE_SEC:
        return AMDResult(
            classification="HUMAN",
            confidence=0.95,
            greeting_duration_sec=greeting_sec,
            silence_duration_sec=silence_after_sec,
            beep_detected=False,
            reason=f"Kısa Türkçe selamlama ({greeting_sec:.2f}s) ve dinleme beklemesi algılandı.",
        )

    # Ara durum (Tek kelimelik çok kısa ses)
    if greeting_sec <= 0.6:
        return AMDResult(
            classification="HUMAN",
            confidence=0.85,
            greeting_duration_sec=greeting_sec,
            silence_duration_sec=silence_after_sec,
            beep_detected=False,
            reason="Hızlı 'Alo' selamlaması algılandı.",
        )

    return AMDResult(
        classification="UNKNOWN",
        confidence=0.55,
        greeting_duration_sec=greeting_sec,
        silence_duration_sec=silence_after_sec,
        beep_detected=False,
        reason=f"Belirsiz konuşma paterni (Konuşma: {greeting_sec:.2f}s, Sessizlik: {silence_after_sec:.2f}s)",
    )


def generate_call_file_content(
    *,
    channel: str,
    callerid: str,
    context: str,
    exten: str,
    priority: int = 1,
    max_retries: int = 3,
    retry_time: int = 300,
    wait_time: int = 30,
    variables: dict[str, str] | None = None,
) -> str:
    """Asterisk .call dosyası içeriğini standart anahtar-değer formatında üretir."""
    lines = [
        f"Channel: {channel}",
        f"CallerID: {callerid}",
        f"MaxRetries: {max_retries}",
        f"RetryTime: {retry_time}",
        f"WaitTime: {wait_time}",
        f"Context: {context}",
        f"Extension: {exten}",
        f"Priority: {priority}",
    ]
    if variables:
        for k, v in variables.items():
            clean_k = str(k).strip()
            clean_v = str(v).replace("\n", " ").strip()
            lines.append(f"Set: {clean_k}={clean_v}")
    return "\n".join(lines) + "\n"


def write_atomic_call_file(
    content: str,
    outgoing_dir: Path | str = DEFAULT_OUTGOING_DIR,
    tmp_dir: Path | str = DEFAULT_TMP_DIR,
    filename_prefix: str = "outbound",
) -> Path:
    """
    Asterisk yarım dosya okuma hatasını (race condition) önlemek için atomik dosya yazımı:
    1. Geçici dizine `.call.tmp` olarak yazılır ve fsync edilir.
    2. Atomik `os.replace` ile hedef `outgoing` dizinine taşınır.
    """
    out_dir = Path(outgoing_dir)
    t_dir = Path(tmp_dir)

    out_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    t_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)

    call_id = f"{filename_prefix}-{uuid4().hex[:12]}"
    tmp_file = t_dir / f"{call_id}.call.tmp"
    target_file = out_dir / f"{call_id}.call"

    # 1. Geçici dosyaya yaz ve diske senkronize et
    with open(tmp_file, "w", encoding="utf-8") as f:
        f.write(content)
        f.flush()
        os.fsync(f.fileno())

    # 2. Atomik olarak hedef dizine taşı
    os.replace(tmp_file, target_file)
    logger.info(f"Atomik .call dosyası oluşturuldu: {target_file}")
    return target_file


class OutboundCampaignDialer:
    """
    Giden Arama, AMI/CallFile ve Türkçe AMD Kampanya Yöneticisi:
    - AMI Originate (Port 5038) ve Atomik Call File (`/var/spool/asterisk/outgoing`) desteği
    - OUTBOUND_UUID ile plaka, fiyat ve müşteri verilerini çağrıya bağlama
    - Türkçe AMD (İnsan vs Telesekreter) ve Voicemail Drop
    - Meşgul/Cevapsız aramalar için otomatik yeniden arama (Auto-Retry)
    """

    def __init__(
        self,
        outgoing_spool_dir: Path | str = DEFAULT_OUTGOING_DIR,
        tmp_spool_dir: Path | str = DEFAULT_TMP_DIR,
        max_retries: int = 3,
        retry_interval_min: int = 15,
    ):
        self.outgoing_spool_dir = Path(outgoing_spool_dir)
        self.tmp_spool_dir = Path(tmp_spool_dir)
        self.max_retries = max_retries
        self.retry_interval_min = retry_interval_min

        # Metrikler
        self.total_originated_ami = 0
        self.total_simulated_ami = 0  # Mock AMI ile "başlatılan" (gerçekte aranmayan) denemeler
        self.total_originated_callfile = 0
        self.total_amd_human = 0
        self.total_amd_machine = 0
        self.total_voicemail_dropped = 0
        self.total_retries_scheduled = 0
        self.total_retries_executed = 0

    async def originate_call_ami(
        self,
        db,
        *,
        appointment_id: str,
        phone: str | None = None,
        call_type: str = "reminder",
        vehicle_plate: str = "",
        quote_price: str = "",
    ) -> OutboundCall:
        """Asterisk AMI Originate (TCP 5038) üzerinden dış arama başlatır."""
        app = db.get(Appointment, appointment_id)
        if not app:
            raise ValueError("Randevu bulunamadı")
        if app.status == "cancelled":
            raise ValueError("İptal edilmiş randevu için arama başlatılamaz")

        target_phone = (phone or app.customer or "").strip()
        if not target_phone:
            raise ValueError("Geçerli bir telefon numarası gerekli")

        # Plaka ve müşteri bilgisi tespiti
        plate = vehicle_plate
        price = quote_price
        if not plate and app.vehicle_id:
            veh = db.get(Vehicle, app.vehicle_id)
            if veh:
                plate = veh.plate or veh.description

        clean_digits = "".join(c for c in target_phone if c.isdigit())
        dial_str = clean_digits if len(clean_digits) >= 7 else target_phone
        channel = f"{settings.ami_channel_prefix}/{dial_str}@{settings.ami_trunk}"

        call_record = OutboundCall(
            appointment_id=appointment_id,
            phone=target_phone,
            customer=app.customer,
            call_type=call_type,
            status="originating",
            outcome="pending",
        )
        db.add(call_record)
        db.flush()

        ami = get_ami_client()
        variables = {
            "OUTBOUND_UUID": str(call_record.id),
            "APPOINTMENT_ID": str(app.id),
            "VEHICLE_PLATE": plate,
            "VEHICLE_PRICE": price,
            "CUSTOMER_NAME": app.customer,
            "CALL_TYPE": call_type,
        }

        try:
            call_record.attempts += 1
            res = await ami.originate(
                channel=channel,
                context=settings.ami_context,
                exten=settings.ami_exten,
                callerid=settings.ami_callerid,
                variables=variables,
                timeout_ms=30000,
            )
            call_record.action_id = res.get("action_id", "")
            # Mock AMI gerçek arama başlatmaz; "in-progress" denirse operatör yanılır.
            if _ami_is_real(ami):
                call_record.status = "in-progress"
                self.total_originated_ami += 1
            else:
                call_record.status = "simulated"
                self.total_simulated_ami += 1
        except Exception as e:
            logger.error(f"AMI Originate hatası: {e}")
            call_record.status = "failed"
            call_record.last_error = str(e)
            db.commit()
            raise RuntimeError(f"Giden arama başlatılamadı: {e}")

        db.commit()
        return call_record

    def originate_call_file(
        self,
        db,
        *,
        appointment_id: str,
        phone: str | None = None,
        call_type: str = "reminder",
        vehicle_plate: str = "",
        quote_price: str = "",
    ) -> tuple[OutboundCall, Path]:
        """Asterisk spool dizinine atomik .call dosyası bırakarak paralel arama başlatır."""
        app = db.get(Appointment, appointment_id)
        if not app:
            raise ValueError("Randevu bulunamadı")
        if app.status == "cancelled":
            raise ValueError("İptal edilmiş randevu için arama başlatılamaz")

        target_phone = (phone or app.customer or "").strip()
        if not target_phone:
            raise ValueError("Geçerli bir telefon numarası gerekli")

        plate = vehicle_plate
        price = quote_price
        if not plate and app.vehicle_id:
            veh = db.get(Vehicle, app.vehicle_id)
            if veh:
                plate = veh.plate or veh.description

        clean_digits = "".join(c for c in target_phone if c.isdigit())
        dial_str = clean_digits if len(clean_digits) >= 7 else target_phone
        channel = f"{settings.ami_channel_prefix}/{dial_str}@{settings.ami_trunk}"

        call_record = OutboundCall(
            appointment_id=appointment_id,
            phone=target_phone,
            customer=app.customer,
            call_type=call_type,
            status="originating",
            outcome="pending",
        )
        db.add(call_record)
        db.flush()

        variables = {
            "OUTBOUND_UUID": str(call_record.id),
            "APPOINTMENT_ID": str(app.id),
            "VEHICLE_PLATE": plate,
            "VEHICLE_PRICE": price,
            "CUSTOMER_NAME": app.customer,
            "CALL_TYPE": call_type,
        }

        call_file_body = generate_call_file_content(
            channel=channel,
            callerid=settings.ami_callerid,
            context=settings.ami_context,
            exten=settings.ami_exten,
            max_retries=self.max_retries,
            retry_time=self.retry_interval_min * 60,
            variables=variables,
        )

        file_path = write_atomic_call_file(
            call_file_body,
            outgoing_dir=self.outgoing_spool_dir,
            tmp_dir=self.tmp_spool_dir,
            filename_prefix=f"outbound_{call_record.id[:8]}",
        )

        call_record.action_id = f"callfile:{file_path.name}"
        call_record.status = "in-progress"
        call_record.attempts += 1
        self.total_originated_callfile += 1

        db.commit()
        return call_record, file_path

    def process_amd_result(
        self,
        db,
        call_id: str,
        amd_result: AMDResult,
    ) -> OutboundCall:
        """
        AMD analiz sonucunu işler:
        - HUMAN: Çağrıyı canlı asistana bağlar.
        - MACHINE: Telesekretere sesli mesaj bırakır (Voicemail Drop).
        """
        call = db.get(OutboundCall, call_id)
        if not call:
            raise ValueError("Arama kaydı bulunamadı")

        if amd_result.classification == "HUMAN":
            self.total_amd_human += 1
            call.status = "in-progress"
            call.outcome = "human_connected"
            logger.info(f"AMD Sonucu: İNSAN algılandı ({call.id}), canlı diyaloğa bağlandı.")

        elif amd_result.classification == "MACHINE":
            self.total_amd_machine += 1
            self.total_voicemail_dropped += 1
            call.status = "completed"
            call.outcome = "voicemail_dropped"
            call.completed_at = now()
            logger.info(f"AMD Sonucu: TELESEKRETER algılandı ({call.id}), sesli mesaj bırakıldı.")

        else:
            call.status = "in-progress"
            call.outcome = "unknown"

        db.commit()
        return call

    def schedule_auto_retry(
        self,
        db,
        call_id: str,
        reason: Literal["busy", "no_answer", "failed"],
    ) -> tuple[OutboundCall, bool]:
        """
        Meşgul (BUSY) veya cevapsız (NOANSWER) aramalarda otomatik yeniden arama planlar.
        Max deneme (3) dolduysa 'unreachable' olarak kapatır.
        """
        call = db.get(OutboundCall, call_id)
        if not call:
            raise ValueError("Arama kaydı bulunamadı")

        if call.attempts >= self.max_retries:
            call.status = "completed"
            call.outcome = "unreachable"
            call.completed_at = now()
            call.last_error = f"Maksimum deneme ({self.max_retries}) aşıldı. Sonuç: {reason}"
            db.commit()
            return call, False

        # Randevu iptal edildiyse yeniden arama yapma
        app = db.get(Appointment, call.appointment_id)
        if app and app.status == "cancelled":
            call.status = "cancelled"
            call.outcome = "cancelled"
            call.completed_at = now()
            db.commit()
            return call, False

        call.status = "retry_scheduled"
        call.outcome = reason
        call.last_error = f"Yeniden arama planlandı ({call.attempts}/{self.max_retries}). Neden: {reason}"
        self.total_retries_scheduled += 1
        db.commit()
        return call, True

    async def process_retry_queue(self, db, limit: int = 10) -> list[OutboundCall]:
        """Yeniden aranması gereken çağrıları bulup tekrar arar."""
        query = (
            select(OutboundCall)
            .where(OutboundCall.status == "retry_scheduled")
            .order_by(OutboundCall.created_at.asc())
            .limit(limit)
        )
        scheduled_calls = db.scalars(query).all()
        retried = []

        for call in scheduled_calls:
            # Randevu durumunu kontrol et
            app = db.get(Appointment, call.appointment_id)
            if not app or app.status in ("cancelled", "confirmed"):
                call.status = "completed"
                call.outcome = "cancelled" if not app or app.status == "cancelled" else "already_confirmed"
                call.completed_at = now()
                continue

            try:
                call.attempts += 1
                call.status = "originating"
                # AMI üzerinden tekrar ara
                clean_digits = "".join(c for c in call.phone if c.isdigit())
                dial_str = clean_digits if len(clean_digits) >= 7 else call.phone
                channel = f"{settings.ami_channel_prefix}/{dial_str}@{settings.ami_trunk}"

                ami = get_ami_client()
                variables = {
                    "OUTBOUND_UUID": str(call.id),
                    "APPOINTMENT_ID": str(app.id),
                    "CUSTOMER_NAME": app.customer,
                    "RETRY_ATTEMPT": str(call.attempts),
                }

                res = await ami.originate(
                    channel=channel,
                    context=settings.ami_context,
                    exten=settings.ami_exten,
                    callerid=settings.ami_callerid,
                    variables=variables,
                    timeout_ms=30000,
                )
                call.action_id = res.get("action_id", "")
                if _ami_is_real(ami):
                    call.status = "in-progress"
                    self.total_retries_executed += 1
                else:
                    call.status = "simulated"
                    self.total_simulated_ami += 1
                retried.append(call)
            except Exception as e:
                logger.error(f"Auto-retry arama hatası ({call.id}): {e}")
                call.last_error = str(e)
                if call.attempts >= self.max_retries:
                    call.status = "failed"
                    call.completed_at = now()

        db.commit()
        return retried

    def get_metrics(self) -> dict[str, Any]:
        """Kampanya ve AMD metriklerini döndürür."""
        return {
            "total_originated_ami": self.total_originated_ami,
            "total_simulated_ami": self.total_simulated_ami,
            "total_originated_callfile": self.total_originated_callfile,
            "total_amd_human": self.total_amd_human,
            "total_amd_machine": self.total_amd_machine,
            "total_voicemail_dropped": self.total_voicemail_dropped,
            "total_retries_scheduled": self.total_retries_scheduled,
            "total_retries_executed": self.total_retries_executed,
            "max_retries": self.max_retries,
            "retry_interval_min": self.retry_interval_min,
        }


# Modül düzeyinde tekil kampanya yöneticisi
campaign_dialer = OutboundCampaignDialer()
````

````python
def normalize_cache_key(text: str) -> str:
    """Metni noktalama ve boşluklardan arındırarak standart önbellek anahtarına dönüştürür."""
    t = text.lower().strip()
    t = re.sub(r"[^\wçğıöşüÇĞİÖŞÜ]", "", t)
    return t


def find_nearest_zero_crossing(signal: np.ndarray, index: int, window: int = 120) -> int:
    """
    Belirtilen indeks civarında sıfır geçişi (zero-crossing) noktasını bulur.
    Böylece ses birleştirmelerinde dijital tıklama/patlama (click/pop) engellenir.
    """
    if len(signal) == 0:
        return 0
    start = max(0, index - window)
    end = min(len(signal) - 1, index + window)
    if start >= end:
        return index

    sub = signal[start:end]
    zero_crossings = np.where(np.diff(np.signbit(sub)))[0]
    if len(zero_crossings) == 0:
        # Minimum mutlak değer noktasını bul
        best_local = int(np.argmin(np.abs(sub)))
        return start + best_local

    best_local = zero_crossings[np.argmin(np.abs(zero_crossings - (index - start)))]
    return start + int(best_local)


@dataclass
class BreathCleaningResult:
    cleaned_samples: np.ndarray
    original_length: int
    cleaned_length: int
    leading_fade_samples: int
    trailing_fade_samples: int
    breath_spikes_detected: int
    comfort_noise_added_samples: int
    sample_rate: int = 8000

    @property
    def cleaned_audio(self) -> np.ndarray:
        return self.cleaned_samples

    @property
    def breath_spike_detected(self) -> bool:
        return self.breath_spikes_detected > 0

    @property
    def leading_trimmed_samples(self) -> int:
        return self.leading_fade_samples

    @property
    def trailing_trimmed_samples(self) -> int:
        return self.trailing_fade_samples

    def to_dict(self) -> Dict[str, Any]:
        return {
            "original_length": self.original_length,
            "cleaned_length": self.cleaned_length,
            "leading_fade_samples": self.leading_fade_samples,
            "trailing_fade_samples": self.trailing_fade_samples,
            "breath_spikes_detected": self.breath_spikes_detected,
            "comfort_noise_added_samples": self.comfort_noise_added_samples,
            "sample_rate": self.sample_rate,
        }


class PauseBreathCleaner:
    """
    Duraksama Nefes Temizleyici ve Akustik Eklem Yumuşatıcı (DSP).
    - Cümle başı ve sonundaki nefes/aspirasyon tepeciklerini (inhalation noise) bastırır.
    - Sıfır geçişi (zero-crossing) ile pürüzsüz birleştirme yapar.
    - Cümle arası duraksama boşluklarına -58 dBFS konfor gürültüsü enjekte eder.
    """

    def __init__(
        self,
        *,
        sample_rate: int = 8000,
        fade_ms: float = 12.0,
        breath_threshold_ratio: float = 0.22,
        comfort_noise_dbfs: float = -58.0,
    ):
        self.sample_rate = sample_rate
        self.fade_ms = fade_ms
        self.breath_threshold_ratio = breath_threshold_ratio
        self.comfort_noise_dbfs = comfort_noise_dbfs
        self.comfort_noise_rms = 10.0 ** (comfort_noise_dbfs / 20.0)

    def clean_waveform_edges(
        self,
        waveform: np.ndarray,
        sample_rate: Optional[int] = None,
        fade_ms: Optional[float] = None,
    ) -> BreathCleaningResult:
        """
        Tek bir ses dalga formunun baş ve sonundaki olası nefes/klik patlamalarını temizler.
        """
        sr = sample_rate or self.sample_rate
        orig_len = len(waveform)
        if orig_len == 0:
            return BreathCleaningResult(
                cleaned_samples=np.zeros(0, dtype=np.float32),
                original_length=0,
                cleaned_length=0,
                leading_fade_samples=0,
                trailing_fade_samples=0,
                breath_spikes_detected=0,
                comfort_noise_added_samples=0,
                sample_rate=sr,
            )

        audio = waveform.copy().astype(np.float32)
        active_fade_ms = fade_ms if fade_ms is not None else self.fade_ms
        fade_samples = max(8, int((active_fade_ms / 1000.0) * sr))
        breath_spikes = 0

        # 1. Başlangıç Nefes Taraması (Leading Inhalation Spike)
        head_window = min(len(audio), int(0.08 * sr))  # İlk 80 ms
        if head_window > fade_samples:
            head_chunk = audio[:head_window]
            rms_head = np.sqrt(np.mean(head_chunk ** 2))
            rms_total = np.sqrt(np.mean(audio ** 2))
            if rms_total > 1e-4 and (rms_head / rms_total) > self.breath_threshold_ratio:
                breath_spikes += 1

        # Başlangıca yumuşak kosinüs fade-in
        fade_in_len = min(fade_samples, len(audio) // 2)
        if fade_in_len > 0:
            fade_in = 0.5 * (1.0 - np.cos(np.linspace(0, np.pi, fade_in_len)))
            audio[:fade_in_len] *= fade_in

        # 2. Bitiş Nefes Taraması (Trailing Aspiration Spike)
        tail_window = min(len(audio), int(0.12 * sr))  # Son 120 ms
        if tail_window > fade_samples:
            tail_chunk = audio[-tail_window:]
            rms_tail = np.sqrt(np.mean(tail_chunk ** 2))
            rms_total = np.sqrt(np.mean(audio ** 2))
            if rms_total > 1e-4 and (rms_tail / rms_total) > self.breath_threshold_ratio:
                breath_spikes += 1

        # Bitişe yumuşak kosinüs fade-out
        fade_out_len = min(fade_samples, len(audio) // 2)
        if fade_out_len > 0:
            fade_out = 0.5 * (1.0 + np.cos(np.linspace(0, np.pi, fade_out_len)))
            audio[-fade_out_len:] *= fade_out

        return BreathCleaningResult(
            cleaned_samples=audio,
            original_length=orig_len,
            cleaned_length=len(audio),
            leading_fade_samples=fade_in_len,
            trailing_fade_samples=fade_out_len,
            breath_spikes_detected=breath_spikes,
            comfort_noise_added_samples=0,
            sample_rate=sr,
        )

    def splice_clauses_with_clean_pause(
        self,
        clause_waves: List[np.ndarray],
        pause_durations_sec: Optional[Union[List[float], float]] = None,
        sample_rate: Optional[int] = None,
        add_comfort_noise: bool = True,
        pause_duration_ms: Optional[float] = None,
    ) -> np.ndarray:
        """
        Birden çok yan cümleyi sıfır geçişiyle ve gürültü kapılı temiz duraksamalarla bağlar.
        """
        sr = sample_rate or self.sample_rate
        if not clause_waves:
            return np.zeros(0, dtype=np.float32)

        parts: List[np.ndarray] = []
        rng = np.random.default_rng(LEYLA_SEED)

        # Duraksama süresini normalize et
        default_pause = 0.15
        if pause_duration_ms is not None:
            default_pause = pause_duration_ms / 1000.0
        elif isinstance(pause_durations_sec, (int, float)):
            default_pause = float(pause_durations_sec)

        for idx, wave in enumerate(clause_waves):
            clean_res = self.clean_waveform_edges(wave, sample_rate=sr)
            cleaned = clean_res.cleaned_samples
            parts.append(cleaned)

            if idx < len(clause_waves) - 1:
                if isinstance(pause_durations_sec, list) and idx < len(pause_durations_sec):
                    pause_sec = pause_durations_sec[idx]
                else:
                    pause_sec = default_pause

                if pause_sec > 0.001:
                    pause_samples_len = int(pause_sec * sr)
                    if add_comfort_noise:
                        # Duraksama aralığına hafif konfor gürültüsü (-58 dBFS)
                        noise = rng.normal(0.0, self.comfort_noise_rms, pause_samples_len).astype(np.float32)
                        # Gürültü kenarlarına 5 ms fade
                        edge_len = min(int(0.005 * sr), pause_samples_len // 2)
                        if edge_len > 0:
                            noise[:edge_len] *= np.linspace(0, 1, edge_len)
                            noise[-edge_len:] *= np.linspace(1, 0, edge_len)
                        parts.append(noise)
                    else:
                        parts.append(np.zeros(pause_samples_len, dtype=np.float32))

        return np.concatenate(parts) if parts else np.zeros(0, dtype=np.float32)


@dataclass
class CacheEntry:
    phrase_id: str
    original_text: str
    normalized_key: str
    slin16_bytes: bytes
    duration_seconds: float
    frame_count_20ms: int
    hit_count: int = 0
    created_at: float = field(default_factory=time.monotonic)


class TelephonyAudioCachePool:
    """
    Sık Kullanılan 25 Kurumsal Cümleyi RAM'de 8 kHz slin16 Formatında Saklayan
    Sıfır Gecikmeli Önbellek Havuzu (Zero Inference Latency Cache).
    """

    def __init__(self, seed: int = LEYLA_SEED, sample_rate: int = 8000):
        self.seed = seed
        self.sample_rate = sample_rate
        self._lock = threading.Lock()
        self._cache: Dict[str, CacheEntry] = {}
        self.total_lookups: int = 0
        self.hit_count: int = 0
        self.miss_count: int = 0

    @property
    def cache(self) -> Dict[str, CacheEntry]:
        return self._cache

    def has(self, text: str) -> bool:
        key = normalize_cache_key(text)
        with self._lock:
            return key in self._cache

    def warm_cache_with_phrases(
        self,
        synthesize_func_or_phrases: Optional[Union[Callable[[str, int], np.ndarray], List[str]]] = None,
        synthesize_func: Optional[Callable[[str, int], np.ndarray]] = None,
    ) -> int:
        """
        En sık kullanılan 25 kurumsal otomotiv cümlesini önbelleğe yükler.
        Gerçek bir sentezleyici verilmezse HİÇBİR şey yüklenmez (yapay/sinüs ses üretilmez);
        önbellek dürüstçe boş kalır.
        """
        loaded = 0
        sr = self.sample_rate

        # Parametre kontrolü (hem phrases listesi hem callable kabul eder)
        if isinstance(synthesize_func_or_phrases, list):
            phrases = synthesize_func_or_phrases
            synth = synthesize_func
        elif callable(synthesize_func_or_phrases):
            phrases = TOP_25_AUTOMOTIVE_PHRASES
            synth = synthesize_func_or_phrases
        else:
            phrases = TOP_25_AUTOMOTIVE_PHRASES
            synth = synthesize_func

        for idx, phrase in enumerate(phrases, start=1):
            key = normalize_cache_key(phrase)
            if key in self._cache:
                continue

            if synth is None:
                # Sentezleyici yok: sahte içerik koymak yerine atla
                continue
            try:
                pcm_float = synth(phrase, self.seed)
            except Exception as e:
                logger.warning("Cümle sentezlenemedi, önbelleğe alınmadı: %s (%s)", phrase, e)
                continue

            # float32 -> int16 slin16 PCM baytları
            int16_arr = np.clip(pcm_float * 32767.0, -32768.0, 32767.0).astype(np.int16)
            slin16 = int16_arr.tobytes()

            dur = len(int16_arr) / float(sr)
            frame_cnt = len(slin16) // FRAME_BYTES_8K_20MS

            entry = CacheEntry(
                phrase_id=f"leyla-cache-{idx:02d}",
                original_text=phrase,
                normalized_key=key,
                slin16_bytes=slin16,
                duration_seconds=round(dur, 3),
                frame_count_20ms=frame_cnt,
            )

            with self._lock:
                self._cache[key] = entry
            loaded += 1

        logger.info("TelephonyAudioCachePool: %d kurumsal cümle RAM'e yüklendi.", loaded)
        return loaded

    def get(self, text: str) -> Optional[bytes]:
        """Metin önbellekte varsa 8 kHz slin16 baytlarını döndürür (0 ms gecikme)."""
        key = normalize_cache_key(text)
        with self._lock:
            self.total_lookups += 1
            if key in self._cache:
                self.hit_count += 1
                entry = self._cache[key]
                entry.hit_count += 1
                return entry.slin16_bytes
            else:
                self.miss_count += 1
                return None

    def get_20ms_frames(self, text: str) -> Optional[List[bytes]]:
        """AudioSocket veya chan_websocket için önceden dilimlenmiş 320-baytlık çerçeveler döndürür."""
        slin16 = self.get(text)
        if not slin16:
            return None

        frames: List[bytes] = []
        for i in range(0, len(slin16) - FRAME_BYTES_8K_20MS + 1, FRAME_BYTES_8K_20MS):
            frames.append(slin16[i : i + FRAME_BYTES_8K_20MS])
        return frames

    def put(self, text: str, slin16_bytes: bytes) -> CacheEntry:
        """Harici olarak sentezlenen bir cümleyi önbelleğe ekler."""
        key = normalize_cache_key(text)
        dur = len(slin16_bytes) / (8000.0 * 2.0)
        frame_cnt = len(slin16_bytes) // FRAME_BYTES_8K_20MS

        entry = CacheEntry(
            phrase_id=f"custom-{hashlib.md5(key.encode('utf-8')).hexdigest()[:8]}",
            original_text=text,
            normalized_key=key,
            slin16_bytes=slin16_bytes,
            duration_seconds=round(dur, 3),
            frame_count_20ms=frame_cnt,
        )
        with self._lock:
            self._cache[key] = entry
        return entry

    def get_metrics(self) -> Dict[str, Any]:
        """Önbellek kullanım ve bellek metriklerini döndürür."""
        with self._lock:
            total_bytes = sum(len(e.slin16_bytes) for e in self._cache.values())
            hit_rate = (
                round((self.hit_count / self.total_lookups) * 100, 2)
                if self.total_lookups > 0
                else None  # hiç sorgu yok: isabet oranı ölçülmedi
            )
            entries_summary = [
                {
                    "phrase_id": e.phrase_id,
                    "text": e.original_text,
                    "duration_seconds": e.duration_seconds,
                    "frame_count_20ms": e.frame_count_20ms,
                    "hit_count": e.hit_count,
                }
                for e in self._cache.values()
            ]

        return {
            "cached_phrases_count": len(self._cache),
            "total_cached_bytes": total_bytes,
            "total_cached_megabytes": round(total_bytes / (1024 * 1024), 3),
            "total_lookups": self.total_lookups,
            "hit_count": self.hit_count,
            "miss_count": self.miss_count,
            "hit_rate_percent": hit_rate,
            "seed": self.seed,
            "warmed": len(entries_summary) > 0,
            "entries": entries_summary,
        }

    def clear(self):
        """Önbelleği temizler."""
        with self._lock:
            self._cache.clear()
            self.total_lookups = 0
            self.hit_count = 0
            self.miss_count = 0


# Global Singleton Instances
pause_breath_cleaner = PauseBreathCleaner()
telephony_audio_cache = TelephonyAudioCachePool()

# Import anında ısıtma YOK: gerçek TTS sentezleyici verilmeden önbellek boş kalır (sahte ses konmaz).
````

## backend/pipeline_telemetry.py

````python
"""FreyaTTS Automotive Cockpit V3 — F0–F6 Pipeline Telemetri Modülü.

Telif Hakkı (c) 2026 Seydi Eryılmaz (@seydivakkas)
ÖZEL LİSANS — TÜM HAKLAR SAKLIDIR
"""

import time
import uuid
from typing import Any, Literal, Optional

StageId = Literal["F0", "F1", "F2", "F3", "F4", "F5", "F6"]
StageStatus = Literal[
    "idle", "queued", "running", "completed", "failed", "cancelled", "skipped", "bypassed"
]


def make_pipeline_event(
    session_id: str,
    turn_id: int,
    stage: StageId,
    status: StageStatus,
    *,
    source: str = "live",
    duration_ms: Optional[float] = None,
    metrics: Optional[dict[str, Any]] = None,
    intermediate_data: Optional[dict[str, Any]] = None,
    error_code: Optional[str] = None,
    error_message: Optional[str] = None,
) -> dict[str, Any]:
    """F0–F6 ortak telemetri sözleşmesine (Schema v3.0) uygun olay sözlüğü üretir."""
    ev = {
        "schema_version": "3.0",
        "event_id": str(uuid.uuid4()),
        "session_id": session_id,
        "turn_id": turn_id,
        "stage": stage,
        "status": status,
        "source": source,
        "timestamp": time.time(),
        "metrics": metrics or {},
    }
    if duration_ms is not None:
        ev["duration_ms"] = round(float(duration_ms), 2)
    if intermediate_data:
        ev["intermediate_data"] = intermediate_data
    if error_code:
        ev["error_code"] = error_code
    if error_message:
        ev["error_message"] = str(error_message)
    return ev
````
