````python
"""Lift and Queue Management Engine for Automotive Inspection Centers.

Telif Hakkı (c) 2026 Seydi Eryılmaz (@seydivakkas) - Tüm Hakları Saklıdır.
"""

from __future__ import annotations

from datetime import datetime, timezone, timedelta
from typing import Any, Optional
from zoneinfo import ZoneInfo
from sqlalchemy import select, func, and_
from sqlalchemy.orm import Session

from backend.db import (
    InspectionLift,
    InspectionQueue,
    Appointment,
    Slot,
    Vehicle,
    now,
)

# Standard inspection package types and durations
PACKAGE_DEFINITIONS: dict[str, dict[str, Any]] = {
    "motor_mekanik": {
        "key": "motor_mekanik",
        "name": "Motor & Mekanik Paketi",
        "duration_minutes": 30,
        "description": "Dyno motor güç testi, şanzıman, alt takım ve sıvı kaçak kontrolleri.",
        "base_price_kurus": 95000,
        "keywords": ["motor", "mekanik", "dyno", "alt takım", "şanzıman", "sadece motor"],
    },
    "standart_ekspertiz": {
        "key": "standart_ekspertiz",
        "name": "Standart Ekspertiz Paketi",
        "duration_minutes": 45,
        "description": "Boya, kaporta mikron testi, motor, mekanik ve OBD elektronik arıza taraması.",
        "base_price_kurus": 145000,
        "keywords": ["standart", "kaporta", "boya", "obd", "orta paket", "genel kontrol"],
    },
    "full_kapsamli": {
        "key": "full_kapsamli",
        "name": "Full Kapsamlı (Tam) Ekspertiz",
        "duration_minutes": 60,
        "description": "500 nokta detaylı kontrol, kaporta, boya, şasi, podye, airbag, dyno motor ve yol testi.",
        "base_price_kurus": 195000,
        "keywords": ["tam", "full", "kapsamlı", "hepsi", "tam ekspertiz", "bütün", "komple"],
    },
    "vip_premium": {
        "key": "vip_premium",
        "name": "VIP Premium & Dijital Ekspertiz",
        "duration_minutes": 75,
        "description": "Full ekspertiz + endoskopi silindir kamera incelemesi, sesli dijital teslimat ve öncelikli sıra.",
        "base_price_kurus": 260000,
        "keywords": ["vip", "premium", "lüks", "endoskopi", "özel paket"],
    },
}


def match_package(text: str) -> dict[str, Any]:
    """Identify requested inspection package from user speech or text."""
    lower = text.lower()
    for pkg_key, pkg_info in PACKAGE_DEFINITIONS.items():
        for kw in pkg_info["keywords"]:
            if kw in lower:
                return pkg_info
    return PACKAGE_DEFINITIONS["standart_ekspertiz"]


def seed_default_lifts(db: Session) -> list[InspectionLift]:
    """Ensure standard inspection lifts exist if none are found."""
    existing = db.scalars(select(InspectionLift).order_by(InspectionLift.lift_number)).all()
    if existing:
        return list(existing)

    defaults = [
        InspectionLift(
            name="Lift-1 (Genel Karoser & Boya)",
            lift_number=1,
            status="idle",
            notes="Standart ekspertiz ve kaporta mikron istasyonu",
        ),
        InspectionLift(
            name="Lift-2 (Dyno & Motor/Mekanik)",
            lift_number=2,
            status="idle",
            notes="Dinamometre ve ağır mekanik alt takım istasyonu",
        ),
    ]
    for lift in defaults:
        db.add(lift)
    db.commit()
    for lift in defaults:
        db.refresh(lift)
    return defaults


def get_all_lifts(db: Session) -> list[InspectionLift]:
    """Retrieve all lifts ordered by lift number."""
    seed_default_lifts(db)
    return list(db.scalars(select(InspectionLift).order_by(InspectionLift.lift_number)).all())


def add_lift(
    db: Session,
    *,
    name: str,
    lift_number: int | None = None,
    notes: str = "",
) -> InspectionLift:
    """Create a new inspection lift in the center."""
    if lift_number is None:
        max_num = db.scalar(select(func.max(InspectionLift.lift_number))) or 0
        lift_number = max_num + 1

    lift = InspectionLift(
        name=name,
        lift_number=lift_number,
        status="idle",
        notes=notes,
    )
    db.add(lift)
    db.commit()
    db.refresh(lift)
    return lift


def set_lift_status(
    db: Session,
    *,
    lift_id: str,
    status: str,
    notes: str = "",
) -> InspectionLift:
    """Set lift status ('idle', 'busy', 'maintenance')."""
    lift = db.get(InspectionLift, lift_id)
    if not lift:
        raise ValueError(f"Lift bulunamadı: {lift_id}")
    if status not in {"idle", "busy", "maintenance"}:
        raise ValueError(f"Geçersiz lift durumu: {status}")

    lift.status = status
    if notes:
        lift.notes = notes
    if status == "idle":
        lift.current_appointment_id = None
        lift.current_vehicle_plate = ""
        lift.started_at = None
    elif status == "maintenance":
        lift.current_appointment_id = None
        lift.current_vehicle_plate = ""
        lift.started_at = None

    db.commit()
    db.refresh(lift)
    return lift


def assign_lift(
    db: Session,
    *,
    lift_id: str,
    appointment_id: str | None = None,
    queue_id: str | None = None,
    plate: str = "",
    package_type: str = "standart_ekspertiz",
) -> InspectionLift:
    """Assign an appointment or queue vehicle to a lift and start inspection."""
    lift = db.get(InspectionLift, lift_id)
    if not lift:
        raise ValueError(f"Lift bulunamadı: {lift_id}")
    if lift.status == "maintenance":
        raise ValueError(f"{lift.name} şu an bakımda olduğu için araç alınamaz.")

    pkg_info = PACKAGE_DEFINITIONS.get(package_type, PACKAGE_DEFINITIONS["standart_ekspertiz"])
    duration = pkg_info["duration_minutes"]

    assigned_plate = plate
    assigned_app_id = appointment_id

    # If linked to appointment, extract vehicle plate
    if appointment_id:
        app = db.get(Appointment, appointment_id)
        if app:
            veh = db.get(Vehicle, app.vehicle_id)
            if veh and veh.plate:
                assigned_plate = veh.plate
            if app.package_type:
                package_type = app.package_type
                duration = PACKAGE_DEFINITIONS.get(package_type, {}).get("duration_minutes", duration)

    # If linked to a queue item
    if queue_id:
        q_item = db.get(InspectionQueue, queue_id)
        if q_item:
            assigned_plate = q_item.plate
            package_type = q_item.package_type
            duration = q_item.duration_minutes
            assigned_app_id = q_item.appointment_id or assigned_app_id
            q_item.status = "in_progress"
            q_item.lift_id = lift.id
            q_item.started_at = now()

    lift.status = "busy"
    lift.current_appointment_id = assigned_app_id
    lift.current_vehicle_plate = assigned_plate
    lift.package_type = package_type
    lift.estimated_duration_min = duration
    lift.started_at = now()

    db.commit()
    db.refresh(lift)
    return lift


def release_lift(db: Session, *, lift_id: str) -> InspectionLift:
    """Complete current inspection on lift and mark it idle."""
    lift = db.get(InspectionLift, lift_id)
    if not lift:
        raise ValueError(f"Lift bulunamadı: {lift_id}")

    # Mark active queue item completed if attached
    active_q = db.scalars(
        select(InspectionQueue)
        .where(
            and_(
                InspectionQueue.lift_id == lift_id,
                InspectionQueue.status == "in_progress",
            )
        )
    ).first()
    if active_q:
        active_q.status = "completed"
        active_q.completed_at = now()

    lift.status = "idle"
    lift.current_appointment_id = None
    lift.current_vehicle_plate = ""
    lift.started_at = None

    db.commit()
    db.refresh(lift)
    return lift


def enqueue_vehicle(
    db: Session,
    *,
    plate: str,
    customer: str,
    package_type: str = "standart_ekspertiz",
    appointment_id: str | None = None,
    vehicle_id: str | None = None,
) -> InspectionQueue:
    """Add a vehicle to the on-site inspection queue."""
    pkg_info = PACKAGE_DEFINITIONS.get(package_type, PACKAGE_DEFINITIONS["standart_ekspertiz"])

    # Determine next queue number (e.g. 101, 102...)
    max_q = db.scalar(select(func.max(InspectionQueue.queue_number))) or 100
    next_q = max_q + 1

    q_item = InspectionQueue(
        queue_number=next_q,
        appointment_id=appointment_id,
        vehicle_id=vehicle_id,
        plate=plate.upper().strip(),
        customer=customer.strip(),
        package_type=package_type,
        duration_minutes=pkg_info["duration_minutes"],
        status="waiting",
        check_in_at=now(),
    )
    db.add(q_item)
    db.commit()
    db.refresh(q_item)
    return q_item


def get_queue(
    db: Session,
    *,
    status: str | None = None,
) -> list[InspectionQueue]:
    """List inspection queue items."""
    stmt = select(InspectionQueue)
    if status:
        stmt = stmt.where(InspectionQueue.status == status)
    stmt = stmt.order_by(InspectionQueue.queue_number.asc())
    return list(db.scalars(stmt).all())


def call_next_queue_item(
    db: Session,
    *,
    lift_id: str,
) -> InspectionQueue | None:
    """Take the next waiting vehicle from queue and assign to lift."""
    next_item = db.scalars(
        select(InspectionQueue)
        .where(InspectionQueue.status == "waiting")
        .order_by(InspectionQueue.queue_number.asc())
    ).first()

    if not next_item:
        return None

    assign_lift(
        db,
        lift_id=lift_id,
        queue_id=next_item.id,
        package_type=next_item.package_type,
    )
    db.refresh(next_item)
    return next_item


def get_lift_capacity_status(db: Session) -> dict[str, Any]:
    """Calculate real-time lift capacity, occupancy, and earliest free time."""
    lifts = get_all_lifts(db)
    total = len(lifts)
    maintenance = sum(1 for l in lifts if l.status == "maintenance")
    busy = sum(1 for l in lifts if l.status == "busy")
    idle = sum(1 for l in lifts if l.status == "idle")
    active = total - maintenance

    # Waiting cars in queue
    waiting_count = db.scalar(
        select(func.count(InspectionQueue.id)).where(InspectionQueue.status == "waiting")
    ) or 0

    all_busy = (busy >= active and active > 0) or active == 0

    # Calculate estimated wait minutes
    now_utc = datetime.now(timezone.utc)
    remaining_minutes_list = []
    unknown_remaining = False  # kalan süresi hesaplanamayan meşgul lift var mı

    for l in lifts:
        if l.status == "busy":
            if not l.started_at:
                unknown_remaining = True
                continue
            try:
                st = datetime.fromisoformat(l.started_at)
                if st.tzinfo is None:
                    st = st.replace(tzinfo=timezone.utc)
                elapsed = (now_utc - st).total_seconds() / 60.0
                rem = max(1.0, float(l.estimated_duration_min) - elapsed)
                remaining_minutes_list.append(rem)
            except Exception:
                unknown_remaining = True  # uydurma 15 dk yok: bilinmiyor

    # Queue waiting durations
    waiting_minutes_sum = db.scalar(
        select(func.sum(InspectionQueue.duration_minutes)).where(
            InspectionQueue.status == "waiting"
        )
    ) or 0

    # Hesaplanamayan değerler None'dır (999 / "--:--" gibi sahte sayı veya yer tutucu yok)
    estimated_wait: Optional[int]
    earliest_time: Optional[str]
    if active <= 0:
        estimated_wait = None
        earliest_time = None
        spoken_msg = "Şu anda tüm liftlerimiz bakımda olduğu için araç alamıyoruz."
    elif not all_busy and waiting_count == 0:
        estimated_wait = 0
        earliest_time = now_utc.astimezone(ZoneInfo("Europe/Istanbul")).strftime("%H:%M")
        spoken_msg = f"Şu an {idle} liftimiz boştur, aracınızı hemen muayeneye alabiliyoruz."
    else:
        # Sum of earliest finish on active lifts + queue backlog divided by active lifts
        # Gerçek lift kalan süreleri + kuyruktaki araçların süreleri; eksik veri varsa None
        if unknown_remaining:
            estimated_wait = None
        else:
            total_backlog = sum(remaining_minutes_list) + waiting_minutes_sum
            estimated_wait = int(round(total_backlog / active))

        # Earliest available completion time (kalan süre bilinmiyorsa None)
        if unknown_remaining or not remaining_minutes_list:
            earliest_time = None
        else:
            earliest_free_min = min(remaining_minutes_list)
            earliest_dt = now_utc + timedelta(minutes=earliest_free_min)
            earliest_time = earliest_dt.astimezone(ZoneInfo("Europe/Istanbul")).strftime("%H:%M")

        # If appointments exist, check earliest available appointment slot
        earliest_slot = db.scalars(
            select(Slot)
            .where(
                and_(
                    Slot.starts_at > now_utc.isoformat(),
                    Slot.id.not_in(
                        select(Appointment.slot_id).where(Appointment.slot_id.is_not(None))
                    ),
                )
            )
            .order_by(Slot.starts_at.asc())
        ).first()

        if earliest_slot:
            try:
                s_dt = datetime.fromisoformat(earliest_slot.starts_at).astimezone(
                    ZoneInfo("Europe/Istanbul")
                )
                earliest_time = s_dt.strftime("%H:%M")
            except Exception:
                pass

        if earliest_time is not None:
            spoken_msg = f"Şu an {busy} liftimiz dolu, en erken saat {earliest_time}'te alabiliyoruz."
        else:
            spoken_msg = f"Şu an {busy} liftimiz dolu; bekleme süresini şu anda hesaplayamıyorum."

    return {
        "total_lifts": total,
        "active_lifts": active,
        "busy_lifts": busy,
        "idle_lifts": idle,
        "maintenance_lifts": maintenance,
        "queue_waiting_count": waiting_count,
        "estimated_wait_minutes": estimated_wait,
        "all_lifts_busy": all_busy,
        "earliest_available_time": earliest_time,
        "spoken_message": spoken_msg,
    }


def check_slot_lift_capacity(
    db: Session,
    slot_start_iso: str,
    duration_minutes: int = 45,
    *,
    exclude_appointment_id: str | None = None,
    seed: bool = True,
) -> bool:
    """Check if center has available lift capacity for the requested timeslot.

    Returns True if slot can be accommodated, False if all lifts are booked.
    """
    lifts = get_all_lifts(db) if seed else db.scalars(select(InspectionLift)).all()
    active_count = sum(1 for l in lifts if l.status != "maintenance")
    if active_count <= 0:
        return False

    try:
        req_start = datetime.fromisoformat(slot_start_iso)
        if req_start.tzinfo is None:
            req_start = req_start.replace(tzinfo=timezone.utc)
    except Exception:
        return True

    req_end = req_start + timedelta(minutes=duration_minutes)

    # Check how many existing appointments overlap with this window
    booked = select(Slot).join(Appointment, Appointment.slot_id == Slot.id).where(
        Appointment.status != "cancelled",
    )
    if exclude_appointment_id is not None:
        booked = booked.where(Appointment.id != exclude_appointment_id)
    boundaries = []
    for s in db.scalars(booked):
        try:
            s_start = datetime.fromisoformat(s.starts_at)
            if s_start.tzinfo is None:
                s_start = s_start.replace(tzinfo=timezone.utc)
            s_dur = getattr(s, "duration_minutes", 30) or 30
            s_end = s_start + timedelta(minutes=s_dur)

            if req_start < s_end and req_end > s_start:
                boundaries.extend(((max(req_start, s_start), 1), (min(req_end, s_end), -1)))
        except (TypeError, ValueError):
            continue
    overlapping_count = 0
    for _, change in sorted(boundaries):
        overlapping_count += change
        if overlapping_count >= active_count:
            return False
    return True
````

## backend/realtime_dashboard_metrics.py

````python
"""
ÖZEL LİSANS — TÜM HAKLAR SAKLIDIR

Telif Hakkı (c) 2026 Seydi Eryılmaz (@seydivakkas)

Bu yazılım ve ilgili tüm dosyalar ("Yazılım") yalnızca görüntüleme ve eğitim
amaçlı olarak paylaşılmıştır.

YASAKLAR:
  1. Kopyalanamaz, çoğaltılamaz, dağıtılamaz veya yeniden yayınlanamaz.
  2. Ticari veya ticari olmayan hiçbir projede kullanılamaz, değiştirilemez.
  3. Alt lisanslanamaz, satılamaz veya devredilemez.
  4. Tersine mühendislik yapılamaz.

İZİN VERİLEN KULLANIM:
  - GitHub üzerinde görüntüleme ve okuma.
  - Kişisel öğrenim amacıyla kodu inceleme (kopyalamadan).

YAZARIN AÇIK YAZILI İZNİ OLMAKSIZIN HİÇBİR KULLANIM HAKKI TANINMAZ.
İzin talepleri için: GitHub @seydivakkas
"""

from __future__ import annotations

import collections
import logging
import threading
from dataclasses import asdict, dataclass
from datetime import datetime, timezone
from enum import Enum
from typing import Any, Dict, List, Optional, Tuple

import numpy as np

from backend.gpu_health_circuit_breaker import CircuitState, gpu_health_circuit_breaker
from backend.pause_breath_cleaner import telephony_audio_cache
from backend.sip_trunk_failover import TrunkStatus, sip_trunk_failover_manager

logger = logging.getLogger("realtime_dashboard_metrics")


class SLAComplianceLevel(str, Enum):
    HEALTHY = "HEALTHY"      # Tüm SLA eşikleri karşılanıyor (%100 uyum)
    WARNING = "WARNING"      # 1-2 metrik uyarı sınırında
    BREACHED = "BREACHED"    # En az bir kritik SLA eşiği aşıldı
    NO_DATA = "veri yok"     # Hiçbir metrik ölçülmedi: uyumlu DEĞİL, bilinmiyor


# Ölçümü olmayan SLA kontrolünün durumu ("geçti" sayılmaz)
NO_DATA_STATUS = "veri yok"


@dataclass
class SLAConfig:
    max_p95_latency_ms: float = 250.0        # P95 inferans gecikmesi < 250 ms
    min_call_answer_rate_pct: float = 98.0   # Çağrı tamamlama / yanıtlama oranı > %98
    min_mos_score: float = 4.1               # Ses kalitesi MOS skoru > 4.1
    max_packet_loss_pct: float = 1.0         # Asterisk AudioSocket paket kaybı < %1.0
    max_gpu_vram_pct: float = 90.0           # GPU VRAM doluluğu < %90
    max_gpu_temp_c: float = 82.0             # GPU çekirdek sıcaklığı < 82°C
    max_queue_wait_sec: float = 30.0         # Maksimum bekleme süresi < 30 sn


@dataclass
class SLACheckItem:
    metric_name: str
    description: str
    target: str
    actual_value: Optional[float]   # None = ölçülmedi
    unit: str
    status: str              # "PASS", "WARN", "FAIL" veya "veri yok"
    is_breached: bool


@dataclass
class SLAReport:
    overall_status: str
    compliance_score_pct: Optional[float]   # None = hiç ölçüm yok
    evaluated_at: str
    total_checks: int
    passed_checks: int
    breached_checks: int
    checks: List[SLACheckItem]

    def to_dict(self) -> Dict[str, Any]:
        return {
            "overall_status": self.overall_status,
            "compliance_score_pct": self.compliance_score_pct,
            "evaluated_at": self.evaluated_at,
            "total_checks": self.total_checks,
            "passed_checks": self.passed_checks,
            "breached_checks": self.breached_checks,
            "checks": [asdict(c) for c in self.checks],
        }


def calculate_itu_mos(
    rtt_ms: float = 25.0,
    jitter_ms: float = 2.0,
    packet_loss_pct: float = 0.0,
) -> float:
    """
    ITU-T G.107 E-Model standardına dayalı tahmini Mean Opinion Score (MOS) hesaplar.
    Mükemmel ses kalitesi: 4.3 - 4.5
    Kabul edilebilir telefon kalitesi: 4.0 - 4.2
    Bozulmuş ses kalitesi: < 3.8
    """
    # Baz R faktörü (G.711 / PCM / Opus)
    r = 94.0

    # Gecikme cezası (Id)
    one_way_delay = (rtt_ms / 2.0) + (jitter_ms * 2.0)
    if one_way_delay > 100.0:
        r -= 0.024 * one_way_delay + 0.11 * max(0.0, one_way_delay - 177.3)
    else:
        r -= 0.024 * one_way_delay

    # Paket kaybı cezası (Ie)
    # %1 paket kaybı ~ 5 R puanı düşürür
    r -= packet_loss_pct * 7.5

    # R-faktörünü 0 - 100 arasına sınırla
    r = max(0.0, min(100.0, r))

    # R faktöründen MOS dönüşümü (ITU-T G.107 formülü)
    if r < 0:
        mos = 1.0
    elif r > 100:
        mos = 4.5
    else:
        mos = 1.0 + (0.035 * r) + (r * (r - 60.0) * (100.0 - r) * 7.0e-6)

    return round(float(np.clip(mos, 1.0, 4.5)), 2)


class RealtimeDashboardMetricsCollector:
    """
    Prometheus / Grafana Exporter ve Canlı SLA İzleme Kolektörü.
    - Yalnızca GERÇEK olaylardan (çağrı başlangıç/bitiş, TTS sentez ölçümü) beslenir.
    - Ölçülmemiş değer None'dur (JSON'da null); Prometheus çıktısında örnek hiç yazılmaz.
    - Veri olmayan SLA kontrolü "veri yok" durumundadır, "geçti" sayılmaz.
    """

    def __init__(self, sla_config: Optional[SLAConfig] = None):
        self.sla_config = sla_config or SLAConfig()
        self._lock = threading.Lock()

        # Telemetri Sayaçları ve Pencereleri
        self.active_calls: int = 0
        self.total_calls_inbound: int = 0
        self.total_calls_outbound: int = 0
        self.total_calls_completed: int = 0
        self.total_calls_failed: int = 0

        # Ağ & AudioSocket: yalnızca gerçek ölçüm gelirse dolar
        self.audiosocket_packet_loss_ratio: Optional[float] = None
        self.audiosocket_jitter_ms: Optional[float] = None

        # TTS & Akustik: ölçüm yoksa None / boş
        self.tts_rtf_ema: Optional[float] = None
        self.inference_latencies: collections.deque = collections.deque(maxlen=200)

        # Müşteri Deneyimi & Kuyruk: yalnızca gerçek (dışarıdan bildirilen) CSAT ve bekleme süreleri
        self.csat_scores: collections.deque = collections.deque(maxlen=100)
        self.queue_wait_times_sec: collections.deque = collections.deque(maxlen=100)

    def record_call_start(self, direction: str = "inbound") -> None:
        """Yeni bir çağrı başladığında sayaçları artırır."""
        with self._lock:
            self.active_calls += 1
            if direction == "outbound":
                self.total_calls_outbound += 1
            else:
                self.total_calls_inbound += 1

    def record_call_end(
        self,
        *,
        success: bool = True,
        duration_sec: Optional[float] = None,
        packet_loss_pct: Optional[float] = None,
        jitter_ms: Optional[float] = None,
        csat_score: Optional[float] = None,
        queue_wait_sec: Optional[float] = None,
        converted_to_appointment: bool = False,
    ) -> None:
        """Bir çağrı tamamlandığında metrikleri günceller.

        converted_to_appointment geriye dönük uyumluluk için kabul edilir ama bellekte
        sayaç tutulmaz: lead/randevu verisi veritabanından hesaplanır.
        """
        with self._lock:
            self.active_calls = max(0, self.active_calls - 1)
            if success:
                self.total_calls_completed += 1
            else:
                self.total_calls_failed += 1

            if packet_loss_pct is not None:
                self.audiosocket_packet_loss_ratio = max(0.0, packet_loss_pct / 100.0)
            if jitter_ms is not None:
                self.audiosocket_jitter_ms = max(0.0, jitter_ms)
            if csat_score is not None:
                self.csat_scores.append(csat_score)
            if queue_wait_sec is not None:
                self.queue_wait_times_sec.append(queue_wait_sec)

    def record_tts_inference(self, duration_audio_sec: float, inference_time_sec: float) -> None:
        """FreyaTTS sentez gecikmesi ve RTF değerini kaydeder."""
        if inference_time_sec > 0:
            rtf = inference_time_sec / max(0.01, duration_audio_sec)
            lat_ms = inference_time_sec * 1000.0
            with self._lock:
                self.inference_latencies.append(lat_ms)
                # RTF EMA (ilk ölçüm doğrudan başlangıç değeridir)
                if self.tts_rtf_ema is None:
                    self.tts_rtf_ema = round(rtf, 3)
                else:
                    self.tts_rtf_ema = round((0.2 * rtf) + (0.8 * self.tts_rtf_ema), 3)

    def get_latency_percentiles(self) -> Dict[str, Optional[float]]:
        """P50, P90, P95 ve P99 inferans gecikmelerini hesaplar; ölçüm yoksa hepsi None."""
        with self._lock:
            arr = list(self.inference_latencies)
        if not arr:
            return {"p50": None, "p90": None, "p95": None, "p99": None}

        np_arr = np.array(arr)
        return {
            "p50": round(float(np.percentile(np_arr, 50)), 1),
            "p90": round(float(np.percentile(np_arr, 90)), 1),
            "p95": round(float(np.percentile(np_arr, 95)), 1),
            "p99": round(float(np.percentile(np_arr, 99)), 1),
        }

    @staticmethod
    def _crm_counts() -> Dict[str, Optional[int]]:
        """Lead ve randevu sayılarını veritabanından okur; okunamazsa None döner."""
        try:
            from sqlalchemy import func, select

            from backend.db import Appointment, Conversation, Session

            with Session() as db:
                leads = db.scalar(select(func.count()).select_from(Conversation))
                appts = db.scalar(
                    select(func.count()).select_from(Appointment).where(Appointment.status != "cancelled")
                )
            return {"total_leads": int(leads or 0), "appointments": int(appts or 0)}
        except Exception:
            logger.debug("CRM sayaçları okunamadı", exc_info=True)
            return {"total_leads": None, "appointments": None}

    def evaluate_sla_status(self) -> SLAReport:
        """Canlı SLA kurallarını değerlendirir; verisi olmayan kontrol "veri yok" olur."""
        now_iso = datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat()
        percentiles = self.get_latency_percentiles()
        p95_lat = percentiles["p95"]

        with self._lock:
            # 1. Yanıtlama / Tamamlama Oranı (çağrı yoksa None)
            total = self.total_calls_completed + self.total_calls_failed
            answer_rate = (
                round((self.total_calls_completed / total) * 100.0, 2) if total > 0 else None
            )

            # 2. Paket kaybı (yalnızca gerçek ölçümse)
            packet_loss_pct = (
                self.audiosocket_packet_loss_ratio * 100.0
                if self.audiosocket_packet_loss_ratio is not None
                else None
            )

            # 3. Kuyruk Bekleme Süresi
            avg_wait = (
                round(float(np.mean(self.queue_wait_times_sec)), 1)
                if self.queue_wait_times_sec
                else None
            )

        # GPU Telemetrisi (kilit dışında; ölçülemeyen değer None)
        gpu_snap = gpu_health_circuit_breaker.sample_telemetry()
        vram_pct = gpu_snap.vram_occupancy_percent
        temp_c = gpu_snap.gpu_temperature_c

        cfg = self.sla_config
        checks: List[SLACheckItem] = []

        def add(name, desc, target, value, unit, breach, warn=False):
            """value None ise 'veri yok'; aksi halde PASS/WARN/FAIL."""
            if value is None:
                checks.append(SLACheckItem(name, desc, target, None, unit, NO_DATA_STATUS, False))
                return
            br = bool(breach)
            checks.append(
                SLACheckItem(name, desc, target, value, unit, "FAIL" if br else ("WARN" if warn else "PASS"), br)
            )

        add(
            "tts_p95_latency", "P95 TTS Sentez Gecikmesi", f"< {cfg.max_p95_latency_ms} ms",
            p95_lat, "ms",
            p95_lat is not None and p95_lat > cfg.max_p95_latency_ms,
            p95_lat is not None and p95_lat > cfg.max_p95_latency_ms * 0.85,
        )
        add(
            "call_answer_rate", "Çağrı Başarı / Yanıtlama Oranı", f">= %{cfg.min_call_answer_rate_pct}",
            answer_rate, "%",
            answer_rate is not None and answer_rate < cfg.min_call_answer_rate_pct,
        )
        # MOS: gerçek ölçüm kaynağı yok (RTCP/ses analizi bağlı değil) → her zaman veri yok
        add("sip_mos_score", "SIP Hat Ses Kalitesi (MOS)", f">= {cfg.min_mos_score}", None, "MOS", False)
        add(
            "packet_loss", "AudioSocket Paket Kayıp Oranı", f"< %{cfg.max_packet_loss_pct}",
            round(packet_loss_pct, 2) if packet_loss_pct is not None else None, "%",
            packet_loss_pct is not None and packet_loss_pct > cfg.max_packet_loss_pct,
        )
        add(
            "gpu_vram_occupancy", "GPU VRAM Bellek Doluluğu", f"< %{cfg.max_gpu_vram_pct}",
            vram_pct, "%",
            vram_pct is not None and vram_pct > cfg.max_gpu_vram_pct,
            vram_pct is not None and vram_pct > 80.0,
        )
        add(
            "gpu_temperature", "GPU Çekirdek Sıcaklığı", f"< {cfg.max_gpu_temp_c} °C",
            temp_c, "°C",
            temp_c is not None and temp_c > cfg.max_gpu_temp_c,
            temp_c is not None and temp_c > 75.0,
        )
        add(
            "queue_wait_time", "Ortalama Kuyruk Bekleme Süresi", f"< {cfg.max_queue_wait_sec} sn",
            avg_wait, "sn",
            avg_wait is not None and avg_wait > cfg.max_queue_wait_sec,
        )

        total_cnt = len(checks)
        evaluated = [c for c in checks if c.status != NO_DATA_STATUS]
        breached_cnt = sum(1 for c in evaluated if c.is_breached)
        passed_cnt = len(evaluated) - breached_cnt

        if not evaluated:
            # Hiçbir metrik ölçülmedi: "geçti" demek yanıltıcı olur
            overall = SLAComplianceLevel.NO_DATA.value
            score: Optional[float] = None
        else:
            score = round((passed_cnt / len(evaluated)) * 100.0, 1)
            if breached_cnt == 0:
                overall = SLAComplianceLevel.HEALTHY.value
            elif breached_cnt <= 2:
                overall = SLAComplianceLevel.WARNING.value
            else:
                overall = SLAComplianceLevel.BREACHED.value

        return SLAReport(
            overall_status=overall,
            compliance_score_pct=score,
            evaluated_at=now_iso,
            total_checks=total_cnt,
            passed_checks=passed_cnt,
            breached_checks=breached_cnt,
            checks=checks,
        )

    def generate_prometheus_metrics_text(self) -> str:
        """
        Prometheus exposition formatında (version 0.0.4) sistem metriklerini üretir.
        Verisi olmayan metriklerin örneği (sample) hiç yazılmaz; 0 basılmaz.
        """
        percentiles = self.get_latency_percentiles()
        gpu_snap = gpu_health_circuit_breaker.sample_telemetry()
        cache_metrics = telephony_audio_cache.get_metrics()
        trunks = sip_trunk_failover_manager.list_trunks()
        crm = self._crm_counts()

        with self._lock:
            active = self.active_calls
            inbound = self.total_calls_inbound
            outbound = self.total_calls_outbound
            completed = self.total_calls_completed
            failed = self.total_calls_failed
            pkt_loss = self.audiosocket_packet_loss_ratio
            jitter = self.audiosocket_jitter_ms
            rtf = self.tts_rtf_ema
            avg_csat = round(float(np.mean(self.csat_scores)), 2) if self.csat_scores else None
            avg_wait = round(float(np.mean(self.queue_wait_times_sec)), 2) if self.queue_wait_times_sec else None

        lines: List[str] = []

        def gauge(name: str, help_text: str, samples: List[Tuple[str, Any]], fmt: str = "{}") -> None:
            """Yalnızca değeri olan örnekleri yazar; hiç örnek yoksa metriği tamamen atlar."""
            valid = [(lbl, v) for lbl, v in samples if v is not None]
            if not valid:
                return
            lines.append(f"# HELP {name} {help_text}")
            lines.append(f"# TYPE {name} gauge")
            for lbl, v in valid:
                lines.append(f"{name}{lbl} {fmt.format(v)}")
            lines.append("")

        gauge("freya_active_calls", "Anlık devam eden toplam aktif telefon görüşmesi sayısı.", [("", active)])
        lines.extend([
            "# HELP freya_calls_total Başlatılan ve sonlanan toplam telefon görüşmeleri.",
            "# TYPE freya_calls_total counter",
            f'freya_calls_total{{direction="inbound"}} {inbound}',
            f'freya_calls_total{{direction="outbound"}} {outbound}',
            f'freya_calls_total{{status="completed"}} {completed}',
            f'freya_calls_total{{status="failed"}} {failed}',
            "",
        ])
        gauge("freya_audiosocket_packet_loss_ratio", "Asterisk AudioSocket paket kayıp oranı (0.0 - 1.0).",
              [("", pkt_loss)], "{:.4f}")
        gauge("freya_audiosocket_jitter_ms", "Asterisk AudioSocket hat gecikme sapması (jitter).",
              [("", jitter)], "{:.2f}")
        # freya_sip_mos_score bilerek yok: gerçek MOS ölçümü bulunmuyor
        gauge("freya_tts_rtf", "FreyaTTS Gerçek Zamanlılık Katsayısı (Real-Time Factor).", [("", rtf)], "{:.3f}")
        gauge(
            "freya_tts_inference_latency_ms", "FreyaTTS ODE inferans gecikmesi yüzdelikleri.",
            [
                ('{quantile="0.50"}', percentiles["p50"]),
                ('{quantile="0.90"}', percentiles["p90"]),
                ('{quantile="0.95"}', percentiles["p95"]),
                ('{quantile="0.99"}', percentiles["p99"]),
            ],
        )
        vram = gpu_snap.vram_occupancy_percent
        gauge("freya_gpu_vram_occupancy_ratio", "GPU VRAM doluluk oranı (0.0 - 1.0).",
              [("", vram / 100.0 if vram is not None else None)], "{:.3f}")
        gauge("freya_gpu_temperature_celsius", "GPU çekirdek sıcaklığı (°C).",
              [("", gpu_snap.gpu_temperature_c)], "{:.1f}")

        # Devre kesici numerik durum: CLOSED=0, HALF_OPEN=1, OPEN=2
        cb_val = 0
        if gpu_snap.circuit_state == CircuitState.HALF_OPEN.value:
            cb_val = 1
        elif gpu_snap.circuit_state == CircuitState.OPEN.value:
            cb_val = 2
        gauge("freya_gpu_circuit_breaker_state", "GPU Devre Kesici durumu (0=CLOSED, 1=HALF_OPEN, 2=OPEN).",
              [("", cb_val)])
        gauge("freya_audio_cache_hit_rate_percent", "RAM ses önbelleği isabet oranı (hiç sorgu yoksa yazılmaz).",
              [("", cache_metrics.get("hit_rate_percent"))], "{:.2f}")
        gauge("freya_customer_csat_average", "Dışarıdan bildirilen gerçek CSAT ortalaması (1.0 - 5.0).",
              [("", avg_csat)], "{:.2f}")
        gauge("freya_queue_wait_time_seconds", "Bildirilen kuyruk bekleme süresi ortalaması.",
              [("", avg_wait)], "{:.1f}")
        gauge("freya_leads_total", "Veritabanındaki görüşme (lead) sayısı.", [("", crm["total_leads"])])
        # Lead dönüşüm oranı yok: görüşme ile randevu arasında bağ tutulmuyor

        # SIP Trunk bazlı metrikler (RTT yalnızca ölçüldüyse)
        status_samples: List[Tuple[str, Any]] = []
        rtt_samples: List[Tuple[str, Any]] = []
        for t in trunks:
            st = t["status"]
            if st == TrunkStatus.HEALTHY.value:
                val: Optional[float] = 1.0
            elif st == TrunkStatus.DEGRADED.value:
                val = 0.5
            elif st == TrunkStatus.DOWN.value:
                val = 0.0
            else:
                val = None  # unknown: durum doğrulanmadı
            status_samples.append((f'{{trunk_id="{t["trunk_id"]}",priority="{t["priority"]}"}}', val))
            rtt_samples.append((f'{{trunk_id="{t["trunk_id"]}"}}', t.get("rtt_ms")))
        gauge("freya_sip_trunk_status", "SIP Trunk hat durumu (1=HEALTHY, 0.5=DEGRADED, 0=DOWN).", status_samples)
        gauge("freya_sip_trunk_rtt_ms", "SIP OPTIONS ping RTT gecikmesi (ms).", rtt_samples, "{:.1f}")

        return "\n".join(lines)

    def get_live_dashboard_summary(self) -> Dict[str, Any]:
        """Grafana panelleri ve web dashboard için konsolide JSON özeti (ölçülmeyen değer null)."""
        sla_report = self.evaluate_sla_status()
        percentiles = self.get_latency_percentiles()
        gpu_snap = gpu_health_circuit_breaker.sample_telemetry()
        cache_metrics = telephony_audio_cache.get_metrics()
        trunks = sip_trunk_failover_manager.list_trunks()
        crm = self._crm_counts()

        with self._lock:
            summary = {
                "timestamp": datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat(),
                "sla": sla_report.to_dict(),
                "telephony": {
                    "active_calls": self.active_calls,
                    "total_calls_inbound": self.total_calls_inbound,
                    "total_calls_outbound": self.total_calls_outbound,
                    "total_calls_completed": self.total_calls_completed,
                    "total_calls_failed": self.total_calls_failed,
                    # Gerçek MOS ölçümü yok
                    "estimated_mos": None,
                    "packet_loss_percent": (
                        round(self.audiosocket_packet_loss_ratio * 100.0, 3)
                        if self.audiosocket_packet_loss_ratio is not None
                        else None
                    ),
                    "jitter_ms": (
                        round(self.audiosocket_jitter_ms, 2) if self.audiosocket_jitter_ms is not None else None
                    ),
                },
                "tts_performance": {
                    "rtf": round(self.tts_rtf_ema, 3) if self.tts_rtf_ema is not None else None,
                    "p50_latency_ms": percentiles["p50"],
                    "p90_latency_ms": percentiles["p90"],
                    "p95_latency_ms": percentiles["p95"],
                    "p99_latency_ms": percentiles["p99"],
                },
                "hardware": {
                    "gpu_name": gpu_snap.gpu_name,
                    "vram_occupancy_percent": gpu_snap.vram_occupancy_percent,
                    "gpu_temperature_c": gpu_snap.gpu_temperature_c,
                    "circuit_state": gpu_snap.circuit_state,
                    "simulated": gpu_snap.simulated,
                },
                "trunks": trunks,
                "audio_cache": {
                    "cached_phrases_count": cache_metrics.get("cached_phrases_count", 0),
                    "hit_rate_percent": cache_metrics.get("hit_rate_percent"),
                    "total_lookups": cache_metrics.get("total_lookups", 0),
                },
                "crm_kpis": {
                    # Gerçek CSAT yalnızca dışarıdan bildirilen puanlardır; tahmini duygu skoru buraya girmez
                    "csat_average": (
                        round(float(np.mean(self.csat_scores)), 2) if self.csat_scores else None
                    ),
                    "total_leads": crm["total_leads"],
                    "appointments_total": crm["appointments"],
                    # Görüşme↔randevu bağı tutulmadığından oran hesaplanamaz
                    "conversion_rate_percent": None,
                    "converted_appointments": None,
                },
            }
        return summary


# Global Singleton Instance
dashboard_metrics_collector = RealtimeDashboardMetricsCollector()
````

## backend/redaction_kvkk_guard.py

````python
"""
ÖZEL LİSANS — TÜM HAKLAR SAKLIDIR

Telif Hakkı (c) 2026 Seydi Eryılmaz (@seydivakkas)

Bu yazılım ve ilgili tüm dosyalar ("Yazılım") yalnızca görüntüleme ve eğitim
amaçlı olarak paylaşılmıştır.

YASAKLAR:
  1. Kopyalanamaz, çoğaltılamaz, dağıtılamaz veya yeniden yayınlanamaz.
  2. Ticari veya ticari olmayan hiçbir projede kullanılamaz, değiştirilemez.
  3. Alt lisanslanamaz, satılamaz veya devredilemez.
  4. Tersine mühendislik yapılamaz.

İZİN VERİLEN KULLANIM:
  - GitHub üzerinde görüntüleme ve okuma.
  - Kişisel öğrenim amacıyla kodu inceleme (kopyalamadan).

YAZARIN AÇIK YAZILI İZNİ OLMAKSIZIN HİÇBİR KULLANIM HAKKI TANINMAZ.
İzin talepleri için: GitHub @seydivakkas
"""

from __future__ import annotations

import logging
import re
from dataclasses import asdict, dataclass, field
from typing import Any, Dict, List, Optional, Set, Tuple, Union

import numpy as np

logger = logging.getLogger("redaction_kvkk_guard")

# Türkçe Rakam Kelimeleri
SPOKEN_DIGITS: Dict[str, str] = {
    "sıfır": "0", "sifir": "0",
    "bir": "1",
    "iki": "2",
    "üç": "3", "uc": "3",
    "dört": "4", "dort": "4",
    "beş": "5", "bes": "5",
    "altı": "6", "alti": "6",
    "yedi": "7",
    "sekiz": "8",
    "dokuz": "9",
}

# Regex Kalıpları
# 1. TCKN: 11 basamaklı sayı (0 ile başlayamaz)
TCKN_REGEX = re.compile(r"\b([1-9]\d{10})\b")

# 2. Kredi / Banka Kartı: 13-19 basamaklı (boşluklu veya tireli: 4543 1234 5678 9012)
CARD_REGEX = re.compile(
    r"\b(?:4[0-9]{12}(?:[0-9]{3})?|5[1-5][0-9]{14}|2(?:2[2-9][0-9]{12}|[3-6][0-9]{13}|7[0-1][0-9]{12}|720[0-9]{12})|3[47][0-9]{13}|9792[0-9]{12}|(?:[0-9]{4}[-\s]?){3}[0-9]{4})\b"
)

# 3. CVV / CVC: "cvv", "cvc", "güvenlik kodu" ardından 3-4 basamaklı sayı
CVV_REGEX = re.compile(
    r"\b(?:cvv|cvc|güvenlik\s*kodu|güvenlik\s*numarası)[:\s]*([0-9]{3,4})\b",
    re.IGNORECASE,
)

# 4. Son Kullanma Tarihi (MM/YY veya MM/YYYY)
EXPIRY_REGEX = re.compile(
    r"\b(?:son\s*kullanma\s*tarihi|skt|sk\s*tarihi)?[:\s]*(0[1-9]|1[0-2])\s*[\/\-]\s*([2-3][0-9]{1,3})\b",
    re.IGNORECASE,
)

# 5. Türkiye Telefon Numarası: 05xx xxx xx xx, +90 5xx ...
PHONE_REGEX = re.compile(
    r"(?:\+?90\s*|0)?(5[0-9]{2})[\s\-]?([0-9]{3})[\s\-]?([0-9]{2})[\s\-]?([0-9]{2})\b"
)

# 6. E-posta Adresi
EMAIL_REGEX = re.compile(
    r"\b[A-Za-z0-9._%+-]+@[A-Za-z0-9.-]+\.[A-Z|a-z]{2,7}\b"
)

# 7. Türkiye IBAN (TR + 24 basamak)
IBAN_REGEX = re.compile(
    r"\bTR\s*(?:[0-9]{2}\s*)(?:[0-9]{4}\s*){5}[0-9]{2}\b",
    re.IGNORECASE,
)


def is_valid_tckn(tckn: Union[str, int]) -> bool:
    """
    T.C. Kimlik Numarası algoritma doğrulaması.
    Kurallar:
      1. 11 basamaktan oluşmalıdır ve tamamı rakam olmalıdır.
      2. İlk basamak '0' olamaz.
      3. (7 * (d1 + d3 + d5 + d7 + d9) - (d2 + d4 + d6 + d8)) % 10 == d10
      4. sum(d1..d10) % 10 == d11
    """
    s = str(tckn).strip()
    if len(s) != 11 or not s.isdigit():
        return False
    if s[0] == "0":
        return False

    digits = [int(c) for c in s]

    # Kural 1: 10. basamak kontrolü
    odd_sum = digits[0] + digits[2] + digits[4] + digits[6] + digits[8]
    even_sum = digits[1] + digits[3] + digits[5] + digits[7]
    d10 = (7 * odd_sum - even_sum) % 10
    if d10 != digits[9]:
        return False

    # Kural 2: 11. basamak kontrolü
    if sum(digits[:10]) % 10 != digits[10]:
        return False

    return True


def is_valid_luhn(card_number: Union[str, int]) -> bool:
    """
    Luhn Algoritması (Mod 10) ile kredi/banka kartı numarası doğrulaması.
    Visa, Mastercard, Troy, Amex standartlarına uygundur.
    """
    clean = re.sub(r"\D", "", str(card_number))
    if len(clean) < 13 or len(clean) > 19:
        return False

    total = 0
    reverse_digits = [int(c) for c in reversed(clean)]
    for i, d in enumerate(reverse_digits):
        if i % 2 == 1:
            doubled = d * 2
            total += (doubled - 9) if doubled > 9 else doubled
        else:
            total += d

    return total % 10 == 0


def is_valid_tr_iban(iban: str) -> bool:
    """
    Türkiye IBAN doğrulaması (Mod 97 kontrolü).
    """
    clean = re.sub(r"\s+", "", str(iban)).upper()
    if len(clean) != 26 or not clean.startswith("TR"):
        return False
    if not clean[2:].isdigit():
        return False

    # TR ve kontrol basamaklarını sona taşı: TRXX -> XX TR -> XX 29 27
    reordered = clean[4:] + str(ord(clean[0]) - 55) + str(ord(clean[1]) - 55) + clean[2:4]
    try:
        return int(reordered) % 97 == 1
    except ValueError:
        return False


def mask_tckn(tckn: str, mask_char: str = "*") -> str:
    """
    TCKN maskeleme: İlk 3 ve son 2 basamağı gösterir, ortadaki 6 basamağı maskeler.
    Örnek: 12345678901 -> 123******01
    """
    s = re.sub(r"\D", "", str(tckn))
    if len(s) == 11:
        return f"{s[:3]}{mask_char * 6}{s[9:]}"
    return mask_char * len(s)


def mask_credit_card(card: str, mask_char: str = "*") -> str:
    """
    Kredi kartı maskeleme: İlk 4 (veya 6 BIN) ve son 4 haneyi gösterir.
    Örnek: 4543 1234 5678 9012 -> 4543 **** **** 9012
    """
    digits = re.sub(r"\D", "", str(card))
    if len(digits) >= 15:
        first4 = digits[:4]
        last4 = digits[-4:]
        middle_len = len(digits) - 8
        groups = []
        groups.append(first4)
        for _ in range((middle_len + 3) // 4):
            groups.append(mask_char * 4)
        groups.append(last4)
        return " ".join(groups)
    return mask_char * len(card)


def mask_phone(phone: str, mask_char: str = "*") -> str:
    """
    Telefon maskeleme: Alan kodu ve son 2 basamağı korur.
    Örnek: 0532 123 45 67 -> 0532 *** ** 67
    """
    clean = re.sub(r"\D", "", str(phone))
    if clean.startswith("90") and len(clean) == 12:
        clean = "0" + clean[2:]
    if len(clean) == 11 and clean.startswith("05"):
        return f"{clean[:4]} {mask_char * 3} {mask_char * 2} {clean[9:]}"
    elif len(clean) == 10 and clean.startswith("5"):
        return f"0{clean[:3]} {mask_char * 3} {mask_char * 2} {clean[8:]}"
    return mask_char * len(phone)


def mask_email(email: str, mask_char: str = "*") -> str:
    """
    E-posta maskeleme: İlk harf, son harf ve etki alanını korur.
    Örnek: ahmet.yilmaz@gmail.com -> a**********z@gmail.com
    """
    if "@" not in email:
        return mask_char * len(email)
    user_part, domain_part = email.split("@", 1)
    if len(user_part) <= 2:
        masked_user = mask_char * len(user_part)
    else:
        masked_user = f"{user_part[0]}{mask_char * (len(user_part) - 2)}{user_part[-1]}"
    return f"{masked_user}@{domain_part}"


def mask_iban(iban: str, mask_char: str = "*") -> str:
    """
    IBAN maskeleme: TR ve son 4 haneyi korur.
    Örnek: TR12 3456 7890 1234 5678 9012 34 -> TR** **** **** **** **** **12 34
    """
    clean = re.sub(r"\s+", "", str(iban)).upper()
    if len(clean) == 26:
        return f"TR{mask_char * 2} {mask_char * 4} {mask_char * 4} {mask_char * 4} {mask_char * 4} {mask_char * 2}{clean[-4:-2]} {clean[-2:]}"
    return f"TR{mask_char * (len(clean) - 2)}"


@dataclass
class RedactionEntity:
    entity_type: str
    raw_value: str
    masked_value: str
    start_pos: int
    end_pos: int
    is_valid: bool


@dataclass
class RedactionResult:
    original_text: str
    redacted_text: str
    entities: List[Dict[str, Any]] = field(default_factory=list)
    redaction_count: int = 0


class KVKKGuard:
    """
    Kurumsal KVKK / GDPR Veri Maskeleme ve Koruma Kalkanı.
    Metin, transkript ve ses kayıtlarındaki hassas kişisel verileri
    algoritmik denetimlerle tespit eder ve maskeler.
    """

    def __init__(
        self,
        *,
        mask_char: str = "*",
        validate_strict: bool = True,
        enabled_categories: Optional[Set[str]] = None,
        beep_freq_hz: float = 1000.0,
    ):
        self.mask_char = mask_char
        self.validate_strict = validate_strict
        self.enabled_categories = enabled_categories or {
            "tckn",
            "credit_card",
            "cvv",
            "expiry",
            "phone",
            "email",
            "iban",
            "spoken_numbers",
        }
        self.beep_freq_hz = beep_freq_hz

    def redact_spoken_numbers(self, text: str) -> Tuple[str, List[RedactionEntity]]:
        """
        Telefonda sesli telaffuz edilen ardışık rakam dizilerini (Örn: 'TC kimlik numaram bir iki üç...')
        çözümler, TCKN veya Kredi Kartı kuralına uyuyorsa maskeler.
        """
        if "spoken_numbers" not in self.enabled_categories:
            return text, []

        tokens = text.split()
        entities: List[RedactionEntity] = []
        i = 0
        result_tokens = list(tokens)

        while i < len(tokens):
            w = tokens[i].lower().strip(".,!?:")
            if w in SPOKEN_DIGITS:
                # Kesintisiz rakam serisini topla
                start_idx = i
                run_digits = []
                while i < len(tokens):
                    cw = tokens[i].lower().strip(".,!?:")
                    if cw in SPOKEN_DIGITS:
                        run_digits.append(SPOKEN_DIGITS[cw])
                        i += 1
                    else:
                        break
                digit_seq = "".join(run_digits)

                # 11 Basamaklı TCKN Kontrolü
                if len(digit_seq) == 11 and (not self.validate_strict or is_valid_tckn(digit_seq)):
                    masked_val = f"[TCKN MASKELENDİ: {mask_tckn(digit_seq, self.mask_char)}]"
                    for k in range(start_idx, i):
                        result_tokens[k] = ""
                    result_tokens[start_idx] = masked_val
                    entities.append(
                        RedactionEntity(
                            entity_type="spoken_tckn",
                            raw_value=" ".join(tokens[start_idx:i]),
                            masked_value=masked_val,
                            start_pos=start_idx,
                            end_pos=i,
                            is_valid=is_valid_tckn(digit_seq),
                        )
                    )
                # 16 Basamaklı Kredi Kartı Kontrolü
                elif len(digit_seq) in (15, 16) and (not self.validate_strict or is_valid_luhn(digit_seq)):
                    masked_val = f"[KART MASKELENDİ: {mask_credit_card(digit_seq, self.mask_char)}]"
                    for k in range(start_idx, i):
                        result_tokens[k] = ""
                    result_tokens[start_idx] = masked_val
                    entities.append(
                        RedactionEntity(
                            entity_type="spoken_card",
                            raw_value=" ".join(tokens[start_idx:i]),
                            masked_value=masked_val,
                            start_pos=start_idx,
                            end_pos=i,
                            is_valid=is_valid_luhn(digit_seq),
                        )
                    )
            else:
                i += 1

        filtered_tokens = [t for t in result_tokens if t]
        return " ".join(filtered_tokens), entities

    def redact_text(self, text: str) -> RedactionResult:
        """
        Metin içindeki tüm hassas kişisel verileri (TCKN, Kredi Kartı, CVV,
        Telefon, E-posta, IBAN) regex ve algoritmik doğrulamalarla maskeler.
        """
        if not text:
            return RedactionResult(original_text="", redacted_text="", entities=[], redaction_count=0)

        current_text = text
        found_entities: List[RedactionEntity] = []

        # 1. Sesli Rakam Dizilerini Çözümle
        current_text, spoken_entities = self.redact_spoken_numbers(current_text)
        found_entities.extend(spoken_entities)

        # 2. IBAN Maskeleme
        if "iban" in self.enabled_categories:
            for match in IBAN_REGEX.finditer(current_text):
                raw = match.group(0)
                valid = is_valid_tr_iban(raw)
                if not self.validate_strict or valid:
                    masked = mask_iban(raw, self.mask_char)
                    found_entities.append(
                        RedactionEntity(
                            entity_type="iban",
                            raw_value=raw,
                            masked_value=masked,
                            start_pos=match.start(),
                            end_pos=match.end(),
                            is_valid=valid,
                        )
                    )
                    current_text = current_text.replace(raw, masked)

        # 3. Kredi Kartı (Luhn Doğrulamalı)
        if "credit_card" in self.enabled_categories:
            for match in CARD_REGEX.finditer(current_text):
                raw = match.group(0)
                clean_digits = re.sub(r"\D", "", raw)
                valid = is_valid_luhn(clean_digits)
                if not self.validate_strict or valid:
                    masked = mask_credit_card(raw, self.mask_char)
                    found_entities.append(
                        RedactionEntity(
                            entity_type="credit_card",
                            raw_value=raw,
                            masked_value=masked,
                            start_pos=match.start(),
                            end_pos=match.end(),
                            is_valid=valid,
                        )
                    )
                    current_text = current_text.replace(raw, masked)

        # 4. CVV / CVC Maskeleme
        if "cvv" in self.enabled_categories:
            for match in CVV_REGEX.finditer(current_text):
                raw_cvv = match.group(1)
                masked_cvv = self.mask_char * len(raw_cvv)
                full_raw = match.group(0)
                full_masked = full_raw.replace(raw_cvv, masked_cvv)
                found_entities.append(
                    RedactionEntity(
                        entity_type="cvv",
                        raw_value=raw_cvv,
                        masked_value=masked_cvv,
                        start_pos=match.start(),
                        end_pos=match.end(),
                        is_valid=True,
                    )
                )
                current_text = current_text.replace(full_raw, full_masked)

        # 5. TCKN Maskeleme (11 Basamak + Algoritmik Doğrulama)
        if "tckn" in self.enabled_categories:
            for match in TCKN_REGEX.finditer(current_text):
                raw = match.group(1)
                valid = is_valid_tckn(raw)
                if not self.validate_strict or valid:
                    masked = mask_tckn(raw, self.mask_char)
                    found_entities.append(
                        RedactionEntity(
                            entity_type="tckn",
                            raw_value=raw,
                            masked_value=masked,
                            start_pos=match.start(),
                            end_pos=match.end(),
                            is_valid=valid,
                        )
                    )
                    current_text = current_text.replace(raw, masked)

        # 6. E-posta Maskeleme
        if "email" in self.enabled_categories:
            for match in EMAIL_REGEX.finditer(current_text):
                raw = match.group(0)
                masked = mask_email(raw, self.mask_char)
                found_entities.append(
                    RedactionEntity(
                        entity_type="email",
                        raw_value=raw,
                        masked_value=masked,
                        start_pos=match.start(),
                        end_pos=match.end(),
                        is_valid=True,
                    )
                )
                current_text = current_text.replace(raw, masked)

        # 7. Telefon Maskeleme
        if "phone" in self.enabled_categories:
            for match in PHONE_REGEX.finditer(current_text):
                raw = match.group(0)
                masked = mask_phone(raw, self.mask_char)
                found_entities.append(
                    RedactionEntity(
                        entity_type="phone",
                        raw_value=raw,
                        masked_value=masked,
                        start_pos=match.start(),
                        end_pos=match.end(),
                        is_valid=True,
                    )
                )
                current_text = current_text.replace(raw, masked)

        return RedactionResult(
            original_text=text,
            redacted_text=current_text,
            entities=[asdict(e) for e in found_entities],
            redaction_count=len(found_entities),
        )

    def redact_audio(
        self,
        audio_data: np.ndarray,
        sample_rate: int,
        time_ranges: List[Tuple[float, float]],
        mode: str = "beep",
    ) -> np.ndarray:
        """
        Ses kaydı üzerindeki hassas zaman aralıklarını sessize alır ('mute')
        veya 1000 Hz sinüs bip sesiyle ('beep') maskeler.
        Tıklama / patlama sesini önlemek için 5 ms kosinüs yumuşatma uygulanır.
        """
        if audio_data is None or len(audio_data) == 0:
            return audio_data

        out = np.copy(audio_data).astype(np.float32)
        total_samples = len(out)
        ramp_len = max(2, int(0.005 * sample_rate))  # 5 ms rampa

        for start_sec, end_sec in time_ranges:
            start_idx = max(0, int(start_sec * sample_rate))
            end_idx = min(total_samples, int(end_sec * sample_rate))
            if end_idx <= start_idx:
                continue

            seg_len = end_idx - start_idx

            if mode == "mute" or mode == "silence":
                # Sessizleştirme (Cosine Fade In / Fade Out ile)
                if seg_len > 2 * ramp_len:
                    fade_out = 0.5 * (1 + np.cos(np.linspace(0, np.pi, ramp_len)))
                    fade_in = 0.5 * (1 - np.cos(np.linspace(0, np.pi, ramp_len)))
                    out[start_idx : start_idx + ramp_len] *= fade_out
                    out[start_idx + ramp_len : end_idx - ramp_len] = 0.0
                    out[end_idx - ramp_len : end_idx] *= fade_in
                else:
                    out[start_idx:end_idx] = 0.0

            elif mode == "beep" or mode == "sine":
                # 1000 Hz Bip Sesi (Genlik -12 dBFS ≈ 0.25)
                t = np.arange(seg_len) / sample_rate
                beep_signal = (0.25 * np.sin(2 * np.pi * self.beep_freq_hz * t)).astype(np.float32)
                if seg_len > 2 * ramp_len:
                    fade_in = 0.5 * (1 - np.cos(np.linspace(0, np.pi, ramp_len)))
                    fade_out = 0.5 * (1 + np.cos(np.linspace(0, np.pi, ramp_len)))
                    beep_signal[:ramp_len] *= fade_in
                    beep_signal[-ramp_len:] *= fade_out

                out[start_idx:end_idx] = beep_signal

            elif mode == "noise":
                # Konfor Gürültüsü (-48 dBFS)
                noise = np.random.normal(0.0, 0.004, seg_len).astype(np.float32)
                out[start_idx:end_idx] = noise

        return out


# Global singleton varsayılan koruma örneği
default_kvkk_guard = KVKKGuard()


def redact_text(
    text: str,
    categories: Optional[Set[str]] = None,
    mask_char: str = "*",
    validate_strict: bool = True,
) -> RedactionResult:
    """Tekil metin maskeleme yardımcı fonksiyonu."""
    guard = KVKKGuard(
        mask_char=mask_char,
        validate_strict=validate_strict,
        enabled_categories=categories,
    )
    return guard.redact_text(text)


def redact_audio(
    audio_data: np.ndarray,
    sample_rate: int,
    time_ranges: List[Tuple[float, float]],
    mode: str = "beep",
    beep_freq: float = 1000.0,
) -> np.ndarray:
    """Ses maskeleme yardımcı fonksiyonu."""
    guard = KVKKGuard(beep_freq_hz=beep_freq)
    return guard.redact_audio(audio_data, sample_rate, time_ranges, mode=mode)


def redact_dialogue_turns(
    turns: List[Dict[str, Any]],
    guard: Optional[KVKKGuard] = None,
) -> Tuple[List[Dict[str, Any]], int]:
    """
    Diyalog turları listesindeki tüm kullanıcı ve asistan metinlerini maskeler.
    Dönen değer: (maskelenmiş_turlar, toplam_maskeleme_adedi)
    """
    active_guard = guard or default_kvkk_guard
    redacted_turns: List[Dict[str, Any]] = []
    total_redactions = 0

    for turn in turns:
        t_copy = dict(turn)
        orig_text = str(t_copy.get("text", ""))
        if orig_text:
            res = active_guard.redact_text(orig_text)
            t_copy["text"] = res.redacted_text
            total_redactions += res.redaction_count
        redacted_turns.append(t_copy)

    return redacted_turns, total_redactions
````

````python
"""Automotive Inspection Report PDF Generator using ReportLab.

Telif Hakkı (c) 2026 Seydi Eryılmaz (@seydivakkas) - Tüm Hakları Saklıdır.
"""

from __future__ import annotations

import io
import json
import os
from pathlib import Path
from typing import Any, Optional

from backend.config import settings

from reportlab.lib import colors
from reportlab.lib.pagesizes import A4
from reportlab.lib.styles import ParagraphStyle, getSampleStyleSheet
from reportlab.lib.units import mm
from reportlab.pdfbase import pdfmetrics
from reportlab.pdfbase.ttfonts import TTFont
from reportlab.platypus import (
    HRFlowable,
    Image,
    KeepTogether,
    Paragraph,
    SimpleDocTemplate,
    Spacer,
    Table,
    TableStyle,
)

FONT_REGULAR = "Helvetica"
FONT_BOLD = "Helvetica-Bold"


def _init_fonts() -> tuple[str, str]:
    global FONT_REGULAR, FONT_BOLD
    candidates = [
        ("Arial", "Arial-Bold", "C:/Windows/Fonts/arial.ttf", "C:/Windows/Fonts/arialbd.ttf"),
        (
            "DejaVuSans",
            "DejaVuSans-Bold",
            "/usr/share/fonts/truetype/dejavu/DejaVuSans.ttf",
            "/usr/share/fonts/truetype/dejavu/DejaVuSans-Bold.ttf",
        ),
    ]
    for reg_name, bold_name, reg_path, bold_path in candidates:
        if os.path.exists(reg_path) and os.path.exists(bold_path):
            try:
                pdfmetrics.registerFont(TTFont(reg_name, reg_path))
                pdfmetrics.registerFont(TTFont(bold_name, bold_path))
                FONT_REGULAR = reg_name
                FONT_BOLD = bold_name
                return FONT_REGULAR, FONT_BOLD
            except Exception:
                continue
    return FONT_REGULAR, FONT_BOLD


_init_fonts()


# Teknisyen belirtmediyse rapor "Orijinal/normal" demez
NOT_STATED = "Belirtilmedi"


def _get_score_badge(score: Optional[int]) -> tuple[str, colors.Color]:
    if score is None:
        return "PUAN YOK", colors.HexColor("#64748B")
    if score >= 90:
        return "KUSURSUZ (A+)", colors.HexColor("#16A34A")
    if score >= 75:
        return "İYİ DURUMDA (B)", colors.HexColor("#0284C7")
    if score >= 50:
        return "ORTA / KUSURLU (C)", colors.HexColor("#CA8A04")
    return "AĞIR HASARLI / RİSKLİ (D)", colors.HexColor("#DC2626")


def generate_inspection_pdf(
    report: Any,
    vehicle: Any,
    appointment: Any = None,
    output_path: str | Path | None = None,
) -> bytes:
    """Generate a multi-page professional vehicle inspection report PDF.

    Returns the raw bytes of the generated PDF. If output_path is provided,
    also writes the PDF to that file path.
    """
    _init_fonts()
    buffer = io.BytesIO()

    # Document setup: A4, 15mm margins
    doc = SimpleDocTemplate(
        buffer,
        pagesize=A4,
        leftMargin=15 * mm,
        rightMargin=15 * mm,
        topMargin=15 * mm,
        bottomMargin=15 * mm,
        title=f"Ekspertiz Raporu - {getattr(vehicle, 'plate', 'Araç')}",
        author="FreyaTTS Automotive",
    )

    styles = getSampleStyleSheet()

    # Custom styles
    title_style = ParagraphStyle(
        "DocTitle",
        fontName=FONT_BOLD,
        fontSize=16,
        leading=20,
        textColor=colors.HexColor("#0F172A"),
    )
    subtitle_style = ParagraphStyle(
        "DocSub",
        fontName=FONT_REGULAR,
        fontSize=9,
        leading=12,
        textColor=colors.HexColor("#475569"),
    )
    h2_style = ParagraphStyle(
        "H2",
        fontName=FONT_BOLD,
        fontSize=11,
        leading=14,
        textColor=colors.HexColor("#1E293B"),
        spaceBefore=8,
        spaceAfter=4,
    )
    body_style = ParagraphStyle(
        "Body",
        fontName=FONT_REGULAR,
        fontSize=8.5,
        leading=11,
        textColor=colors.HexColor("#334155"),
    )
    bold_style = ParagraphStyle(
        "BoldText",
        fontName=FONT_BOLD,
        fontSize=8.5,
        leading=11,
        textColor=colors.HexColor("#0F172A"),
    )
    badge_style = ParagraphStyle(
        "BadgeText",
        fontName=FONT_BOLD,
        fontSize=10,
        leading=12,
        alignment=1,  # Center
        textColor=colors.white,
    )
    table_cell = ParagraphStyle(
        "TableCell",
        fontName=FONT_REGULAR,
        fontSize=8,
        leading=10,
        textColor=colors.HexColor("#1E293B"),
    )
    table_cell_bold = ParagraphStyle(
        "TableCellBold",
        fontName=FONT_BOLD,
        fontSize=8,
        leading=10,
        textColor=colors.HexColor("#0F172A"),
    )

    story = []

    # 1. Header Banner

    # Build document

    pdf_bytes = buffer.getvalue()
````
